items.title: PQ/T 混合方案术语
items.text: 协议 ：PQ/T 混合方案术语（Terminology for Post-Quantum Traditional Hybrid Schemes）。可引用的权威文本是术语文件 RFC 9794，它把混合方案讲清楚：§4「PQ/T hybrid protocol: A protocol that uses two or more component algorithms providing the same cryptographic functionality, where at least one is a post-quantum algorithm and at least one is a traditional algorithm.」同节还给出复合式定义——字段与消息流与单算法版本相同的形态。 混合的理由是后量子算法本身也可能被攻破：§2「it should not be assumed that an algorithm will not be compromised just because it is designed to provide post-quantum cryptography.」§1 记录先取后藏的威胁：「Data encrypted today (in 2025) with an algorithm vulnerable to a quantum computer can be stored for decryption by a future attacker with a CRQC.」§5 给出混合属性的定义式表述：只要有一个提供该功能的组件算法仍然安全，性质就成立。 术语用于区分两种落地路径：§4 用「PQ/T hybrid protocol with composite key establishment」描述在协议字段与消息流不变的前提下引入混合 KEM，用 composite data authentication 描述把 PQ 与 traditional 签名一起呈现为单一接口的做法。§5 则给出选型提示：为互通而做的混合必须满足混合互通性，而为实现安全而做的混合「will likely require」混合机密性或混合认证——原文保留概率措辞。同节还强调「It is not possible for one PQ/T hybrid scheme or PQ/T hybrid protocol to achieve all of the properties in this section.」 限制集中在两点。第一，同时提供机密性与认证的协议未必两种混合性质都有：§5 说「PQ/T hybrid protocols that offer both confidentiality and authentication do not necessarily offer both hybrid confidentiality and hybrid authentication.」并举例基于 RFC 5280 单算法证书时只有单算法认证。第二，混合证书不是必然给出混合身份认证：§6「The use of a PQ/T hybrid certificate does not necessarily achieve hybrid authentication of the identity of the sender; this is determined by properties of the chain of trust.」 技术参数与复算边界 该条目的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：PQ/T 混合方案术语的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。 预期输出：按 PQ/T 混合方案术语 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。 复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。 - Wikipedia search entry for PQ/T 混合方案术语. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=PQ%2FT%20%E6%B7%B7%E5%90%88%E6%96%B9%E6%A1%88%E6%9C%AF%E8%AF%AD - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\] PQ/T 混合方案术语的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。1.把协议消息序列写成状态机。2.用混合论证逐个替换原语。3.把剩余优势归约到 PRF/AEAD 安全。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 时间型一次性密码
items.text: 术语 ：时间型一次性密码（TOTP）。RFC 6238 把 TOTP 定义为「extension of the… HMAC-based One-Time Password (HOTP) algorithm, as defined in [RFC4226], to support the time-based moving factor」，并要求「The algorithm MUST use HOTP [RFC4226] as a key building block」。核心关系是「TOTP = HOTP(K, T)」，其中「T = (Current Unix time - T0) / X, where the default floor function is used」；X 是以秒为单位的时间步（默认 30 秒），T0 是开始计步的 Unix 时间（默认 0，即纪元）。 把移动因子换成时间，双方无需同步计数器，但代价是必须容忍时钟偏差。§5.2 建议「at most one time step is allowed as the network delay」，并推荐 30 秒的时间步作为「a balance between security and usability」。§1.2 说明默认构造基于 HMAC-SHA-1（RFC 2104），同时允许「MAY use HMAC-SHA-256 or HMAC-SHA-512 functions … instead of the HMAC-SHA-1 function」。 实现要求为每个证明者使用唯一密钥：「There MUST be a unique secret (key) for each prover」，密钥「SHOULD be randomly generated or derived using key derivation algorithms」，密钥库「The key store MUST be in a secure area」，通信「SHOULD take place over a secure channel, e.g., … (SSL/TLS)」。§4.2 还要求实现「MUST support a time value T larger than a 32-bit integer when it is beyond the year 2038」。 强度来自底层 HOTP：§5.1 说「The security and strength of this algorithm depend on the properties of the underlying building block HOTP」，而 HOTP 的构造基于 HMAC 与 SHA-1；同一节也认为「the best possible attack against the HOTP function is the brute force attack」。时间窗口带来额外暴露：§5.2 警告「When an OTP is generated and exposed to a third party before it is consumed, the third party can consume the OTP within the time-step window」，因此要求「The verifier MUST NOT accept the second attempt of the OTP after the successful validation」以保证一次性使用。§6 给出偏差上限：接受两个时间步回退时，最大时间漂移约 89 秒。 RFC 6238「TOTP: Time-Based One-Time Password Algorithm」由 M’Raihi、Machani、Pei 与 Rydell 撰写，2011 年 5 月发布，类别为 Informational，并自我说明「not an Internet Standards Track specification」；它构建在 2005 年标准化的 HOTP（RFC 4226）之上，把计数器替换为时间。 - Wikipedia search entry for 时间型一次性密码. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E6%97%B6%E9%97%B4%E5%9E%8B%E4%B8%80%E6%AC%A1%E6%80%A7%E5%AF%86%E7%A0%81 - RFC 4949: Internet Security Glossary, Version 2. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4949 定义检查模型 上位概念 → 区别特征 → 正例 → 反例 → 易混边界。正例必须落在外延内；反例必须刚好跨过边界；同义词不能代替定义。

items.title: 零信任架构
items.text: 术语 ：零信任架构（Zero Trust Architecture）。SP 800-207 摘要把零信任定义为「an evolving set of cybersecurity paradigms that move defenses from static, network-based perimeters to focus on users, assets, and resources」，§2 进一步说明它是「a cybersecurity paradigm focused on resource protection and the premise that trust is never granted implicitly but must be continually evaluated」。零信任架构则是「an enterprise's cybersecurity plan that utilizes zero trust concepts and encompasses component relationships, workflow planning, and access policies」。 §2.1 列出七条基本信条：把所有数据源与计算服务视为资源；所有通信无论位置都受保护；对单个资源的访问按每次会话授予；访问由动态策略决定；企业持续度量自有与相关资产的完整性与安全态势；认证与授权动态且严格先行；并尽可能收集资产、网络与通信的当前状态信息用于改进防护。§2.2 的第一条假设是「The entire enterprise private network is not considered an implicit trust zone」。 授权的实现由两个组件承担：「Access is granted through a policy decision point (PDP) and corresponding policy enforcement point (PEP)」，其中 PDP 分为作出决定的策略引擎与建立/切断路径的策略管理员；PEP 负责「enabling, monitoring, and eventually terminating connections between a subject and an enterprise resource」。§3.4.1 的网络要求第 4 条写明「Enterprise resources should not be reachable without accessing a PEP」，§2 还要求隐含信任区「must be as small as possible」。 §1 明确「ZT is not a single architecture but a set of guiding principles for workflow, system design and operations」，附录 B 也写明「there is no single solution that provides all the necessary components」。落地受现实约束：§7 说实施 ZTA 是「a journey rather than a wholesale replacement of infrastructure or processes」，§7.2 指出几乎没有企业能在一次技术更新中完成迁移。§5.4 还提醒相当多流量对第三层分析工具「opaque」，无法深度包检查的企业必须使用其他手段。 SP 800-207《Zero Trust Architecture》由 Rose、Borchert、Mitchell 与 Connelly 撰写，2020 年 8 月发布；§1 把零信任定位为旨在防止数据泄露并限制内部横向移动的企业安全架构，并强调这些信条是理想目标，未必能以纯粹形式全部实现。 - Wikipedia search entry for 零信任架构. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E9%9B%B6%E4%BF%A1%E4%BB%BB%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84 - RFC 4949: Internet Security Glossary, Version 2. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4949 定义检查模型 上位概念 → 区别特征 → 正例 → 反例 → 易混边界。正例必须落在外延内；反例必须刚好跨过边界；同义词不能代替定义。

items.title: HMAC 密钥化哈希消息认证码
items.text: 算法 ：HMAC 密钥化哈希认证码（Hash-based Message Authentication Code）。留存 RFC 2104 文本在摘要段给出定义：「This document describes HMAC, a mechanism for message authentication using cryptographic hash functions.」其下一句交代它与密钥和哈希的结合方式：「HMAC can be used with any iterative cryptographic hash function, e.g., MD5, SHA-1, in combination with a secret shared key.」两句都在文首 Abstract 段（本副本报为 front）。原理骨架即此：以迭代型哈希函数为构件、配一把共享秘密密钥，产出一个消息认证码；强度归属见同一段的「The cryptographic strength of HMAC depends on the properties of the underlying hash function.」 §2 把构造写成可执行的七步。先定义两个定串：「ipad = the byte 0x36 repeated B times」与「opad = the byte 0x5C repeated B times.」（两行明文各占一行，0x5C 按原文大小写书写），随后一行给出整体式「H(K XOR opad, H(K XOR ipad, text))」。步骤按原文编号为：「(1) append zeros to the end of K to create a B byte string」、「(4) apply H to the stream generated in step (3)」、「(5) XOR (bitwise exclusive-OR) the B byte string computed in」（该行到此为止，「step (1) with opad」在下一行，故只引至此）、「(7) apply H to the stream generated in step (6) and output」。长密钥规则同段印作「Applications that use keys longer…than B bytes will first hash the key using H and then use the…resultant L byte string as the actual key to HMAC.」（该句被硬回车切成三行，此处按行分段引用，省略号即换行处）。逐步算例（Test Case 2，复算记在 hmac-calc-construction-steps）：密钥 4a656665 按步骤 (1) 补零成 64 字节的分组键；步骤 (2) 与 ipad 异或，得到以 7c535053 开头、其后 60 字节全为 36 的串；步骤 (5) 与 opad 异或，得到以 16393a39 开头、其后 60 字节全为 5c 的串；步骤 (4) 的中间摘要长 32 字节；步骤 (7) 的输出为 5bdcc146bf60754e6a042426089575c75a003f089d2739839dec58b964ec3843，与留存件 RFC 4231 §4.3 第 203-204 行所印一致。中间量是本批次按上述步骤算出的，留存件只印最终值。 §1 说明其构造取向：「This document specifies HMAC using a generic cryptographic hash function (denoted by H).」并紧跟实例化要求：「Specific instantiations of HMAC need to define a particular hash function.」——文件定义的是与具体哈希无关的通用构造，实例化时才选定哈希。这解释了为什么要以 可替换底层哈希 的嵌套结构来做 MAC：既有软件里表现良好、代码随处可得的哈希函数无需改动即可复用。摘要段那句把强度前提也归到底层哈希：「The cryptographic strength of HMAC depends on the properties of the underlying hash function.」（front）。于是动机是复用现成哈希并保留其性能，同时把安全性下推到对 H 的常规假设。 使用条件散在编号小节，措辞有 must 级也有 recommend 级。§3 对密钥的取法是祈使式陈述：「Keys need to be chosen at random (or using a cryptographically strong pseudo-random generator seeded with a random seed), and periodically refreshed.」——密钥须随机选择并定期刷新。§5 对截断输出给的是 recommend：「We recommend that the output length t be not less than half the length of the hash output (to match the birthday attack bound) and not less than 80 bits」即截断后的长度 t 建议不小于哈希输出的一半且不少于 80 位。用途因此是把 HMAC 套在某一具体哈希上作消息认证，并对密钥管理与输出截断给出上述两级指引；该条目据的是 RFC 2104 文本，而非目录行的首要引用 FIPS 198-1。留存 RFC 4231 §4.1 交代这批测试向量的地位：「The test vectors in this document have been cross-verified by three」接「independent implementations.」——同一句被硬回车切成两行，故分两段引。取值形式由一句说明：「Keys, data, and digests are provided in hex.」§4.2 至 §4.8 的七个用例各自印一行说明其覆盖面：密钥短于输出长度的「Test with a key shorter than the length of the HMAC output.」、密钥与数据合计长度超过 64 字节的「Test with a combined length of key and data that is larger than 64」接「bytes (= block-size of SHA-224 and SHA-256).」、输出截断的「Test with a truncation of output to 128 bits.」、以及密钥超过 128 字节的「Test with a key larger than 128 bytes (= block-size of SHA-384 and」接「SHA-512).」。§3.2 另印一句「element may specify the truncated length of the scheme output.」即截断后的长度由该元素指定。该条目复算的期望值就是这些明文所印的值。七个用例的密钥、数据与四种摘要都是逐值可定位的：本批次把从留存件读取的每个值连同其行号存入 hmac-vectors.json（提取器读的是 build/corpora.json 为源标识 rfc4231 登记的那份文件），并在 artefacts 里记下两处版式事实：Test Case 3 的密钥标签印作 Key 而没有其余六个用例都带的等号；Test Case 5 的四个摘要只印 16 字节，因为该用例把输出截断到 128 位。复算结果记在 calculations 中：28 个明文摘要全部由按 §2 步骤写出的构造复现，另与 Node.js 自带实现逐一对齐。本批次的复算覆盖：7 个用例乘 4 种摘要共 28 个明文摘要，全部由按 §2 步骤写出的实现复现（hmac-calc-rfc4231-vectors）；Test Case 5 的 16 字节输出与截断规则相对（hmac-calc-truncation-rule）；Test Case 6、7 的 131 字节密钥走 H(K) 分支且与以 H(K) 为密钥的结果相等（hmac-calc-longkey-rule）；另有 140 组长度组合与 Node.js 自带实现逐一对齐（hmac-calc-oracle-agreement）。这些一致性与断言的对应关系记在该档案的 calculations 与 verification-results 中。 限度写在两处。§1 记底层哈希的现状：「MD5 has been recently shown to be vulnerable to collision search attacks [Dobb].」并限定其影响面：「This attack and other currently known weaknesses of MD5 do not compromise the use of MD5 within HMAC as specified in this document (see [Dobb]); however, SHA-1 appears to be a cryptographically stronger function.」——已知的 MD5 碰撞攻击当时尚未危及 HMAC 内的 MD5 使用，但 SHA-1 被评述为更强。§6 给出理论上的最强攻击（该句在原文里紧跟带 ASCII 引号的 birthday attack 一词，此处只引到 H 为止）：「The strongest attack known against HMAC is based on the frequency of collisions for the hash function H」即攻击面被归结为底层 H 的碰撞频率。两条合说：HMAC 的安全性随所选哈希的碰撞抗力而变，MD5 这类构件是其明文点名的弱点来源。 门面按留存文本连读：标题行印 HMAC: Keyed-Hashing for Message Authentication，作者行 Krawczyk、Bellare、Canetti，头部印 Request for Comments: 2104 与 Category: Informational（头部行复述于引号外）。其 Status of This Memo 段三句为：「This memo provides information for the Internet community.」 「This memo does not specify an Internet standard of any kind.」 「Distribution of this memo is unlimited.」——信息类文档，不规定任何因特网标准。版本口径分歧在此记录：本留存文件的日期行印 February 1997，而目录行把 RFC 2104 记作 RFC 2104(1999) 并将 FIPS 198-1(2008) 列为首要引用；该条目所有断言均以留存 RFC 2104 文本为准，日期从文本所印。 - Wikipedia search entry for HMAC 密钥化哈希认证码. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=HMAC%20%E5%AF%86%E9%92%A5%E5%8C%96%E5%93%88%E5%B8%8C%E8%AE%A4%E8%AF%81%E7%A0%81 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 复算示例 取标准或公开测试向量中的一组参数，按“输入—执行—输出”记录：先写出该条目的形式式 \(T=\mathrm{MAC}_K(M)\)；再按规范顺序执行每一步，最后把输出与独立实现或标准向量逐字节对照。若没有可引用的数值向量，就只记录结构步骤，不伪造输出。

items.title: ML-KEM / Kyber 模格密钥封装机制
items.text: 算法 ：Kyber / ML-KEM 封装机制（Kyber;Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism）。留存 FIPS 203 文本在 Abstract 段给出方案类别与机制：「A key-encapsulation mechanism (KEM) is a set of algorithms that, under certain conditions, can be used by two parties to establish a shared secret key over a public channel.」并点名本标准所规定的具体 KEM：「This standard specifies a key-encapsulation mechanism called ML-KEM.」再给出其安全归约：「The security of ML-KEM is related to the computational difficulty of the Module Learning with Errors problem.」原理即此——ML-KEM 是建立在模格/带错误学习（MLWE）困难性上的密钥封装机制，双方经公开信道封装/解封装得到同一共享密钥。（§3.1 另有一义近乎相同的定义句，该条目据 Abstract 立论。） §1.1 给出取它而非旧的密钥建立方案的理由：「The key establishment schemes specified in SP 800-56A and SP 800-56B are vulnerable to attacks that use sufficiently-capable quantum computers.」即基于分解与离散对数的既有 KEM/KDF 方案会被足够强的量子计算机所破。Abstract 随即给出 ML-KEM 的定位：「At present, ML-KEM is believed to be secure, even against adversaries who possess a quantum computer.」两句连读是本机制存在的理由——填补离散对数类密钥交换在量子计算下的失效。措辞是 believed（ 目前被认为 ），文件亦在 §13 声明每五年正式重估，故此 抗量子 是当下评估结论而非已证明之事实，该条目不把它拔高为无条件保证。 用途由参数集与安全性档位两面界定。Abstract 列三档参数集：「This standard specifies three parameter sets for ML-KEM.In order of increasing security strength and decreasing performance, these are ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-768, and ML-KEM-1024.」§3.2 说明其经 FO 变换后达到的攻击模型：「As a result, ML-KEM is believed to satisfy so-called IND-CCA2 security」即选择密文安全（IND-CCA2）。两句合起来是使用面貌：ML-KEM 以 512/768/1024 三档在安全强度与性能间取舍，用作对未授权方保密、面向 CCA2 攻击模型的密钥封装。强度序列是 递增/递减 的描述性排序，本文件另在别处（§1.1）声明三档均获批保护联邦非涉密通信；措辞仍是 believed，不作证明性断言。 限度落在内部构件与实现约束。§3.2 直陈组件不可单独使用：「The scheme K-PKE is not IND-CCA2-secure and shall not be used as a stand-alone scheme (see Section 3.3).」§3.3 再以 shall not 重申：「The public-key encryption scheme K-PKE described in Section 5 shall not be used as a stand-alone cryptographic scheme.」两句是 must 级禁令，把底层明文 PKE（K-PKE）排除于独立使用之外——它只作 ML-KEM 的子程序。另外的限度属评估而非禁令：量子安全是 目前被认为 （见 why 段），且文件自陈符合标准不等于实现安全，须由实现者负责模块的整体安全设计。该条目据留存文本给出这两类限度，不断言 ML-KEM 已被攻破。 标准与候选的关系在留存文本里写得很直白。§1.1：「ML-KEM is derived from the round-three version of the CRYSTALS-KYBER KEM [4], a submission in the NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography Standardization project.」§1.2 定名：「Throughout this standard, the KEM specified here will be referred to as ML-KEM, as it is based on the Module Learning With Errors assumption.」门面板块（Title block）所印标题为 Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard，并印 Published August 13, 2024 与 Published: August 13, 2024 Effective: August 13, 2024，其免费获取行为 This publication is available free of charge from:（其后 DOI 置于引号外）。目录行仍以候选名 Kyber 指称该算法，而留存文件是已定稿的标准：它把算法称作 ML-KEM，CRYSTALS-KYBER 仅作为其标准化来源出现；两处措辞（Kyber 对 ML-KEM）与文档日期（候选材料 2022 对定稿 2024）的差别即在此记录，该条目据文件所印的 ML-KEM 与 2024-08-13 立论。 - Wikipedia search entry for Kyber / ML-KEM 封装机制. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=Kyber%20%2F%20ML-KEM%20%E5%B0%81%E8%A3%85%E6%9C%BA%E5%88%B6 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[(c,k)=\mathrm{Encaps}(pk);\qquad k'=\mathrm{Decaps}(sk,c)\] Kyber / ML-KEM 封装机制的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：pk 公钥，sk 私钥，c 密文，k 会话密钥。1.封装方采样随机种子并生成密文。2.解封装方用私钥恢复种子。3.双方得到同一会话密钥并校验。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: SLH-DSA 无状态哈希基数字签名
items.text: 算法 ：SLH-DSA 状态哈希签名（SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+) stateless hash-based signature algorithm）。留存 FIPS 205 文本在 Abstract 段定名：「This standard specifies the stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm (SLH-DSA).」§3 给出构造骨架：「SLH-DSA is a stateless hash-based signature scheme that is constructed using other hash-based signature schemes as components:」并列出两类组件——「a few-time signature scheme, forest of random subsets (FORS), and (2) a multi-time signature scheme, the eXtended Merkle Signature Scheme (XMSS).」原理即此：SLH-DSA 以少次签名 FORS 与多次签名 XMSS（后者又建于一次性签名 WOTS+）为构件，组合成一个无状态、以哈希为基的数字签名。该条目据算法在标准文本里的自述立论，与记述该出版物的 fips205 标准记录相区别。 §1.1 说明它与既有签名的区别及理由：「Unlike the algorithms specified in FIPS 186-5 [1], SLH-DSA is designed to provide resistance against attacks from a large-scale quantum computer.」即相较于经典数字签名标准，它是为抗量子攻击而设计。其同段给出安全前提：「The security of the stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm (SLH-DSA) relies on the presumed difficulty of finding preimages for hash functions」——其安全归于哈希原像的困难性。Abstract 补上来源：「SLH-DSA is based on SPHINCS+, which was selected for standardization as part of the NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography Standardization process.」理由链因此是：经典签名在量子下失效，而以哈希原像困难为基础、无状态、由 SPHINCS+ 标准化的方案可提供量子抗力。措辞是 presumed difficulty，不作证明性断言。 使用约束在编号小节，措辞层级分明。§3.2 对组件外泄给出 should not：「As WOTS+, XMSS, FORS, and hypertree signature schemes are not approved for use as stand-alone signature schemes, cryptographic modules should not make interfaces to these components available to applications.」即组件仅用于拼出 SLH-DSA，模块不宜把它们做成对外接口。§3.1 对算术给出 shall not：「Implementations of SLH-DSA shall not use floating-point arithmetic, as rounding errors in floating point operations may lead to incorrect results in some cases.」——实现不得用浮点运算，理由是舍入误差可能致错。用途面貌因此是把 SLH-DSA 作整体签名方案使用，组件不作独立接口对外（should not），算术须避免浮点（shall not）。should not 与 shall not 在此不可互换。 留存文本自陈的限度在实现与前提两面。§3.2 记侧信道与故障攻击敞口：「Care must be taken to protect implementations against attacks, such as side-channel attacks or fault attacks [17, 18, 19, 20, 21].」即私钥保密性关键，实现须防侧信道与故障提取。前提侧的限度见 why 段所引：其安全系于哈希原像之 presumed difficulty，而非归约到已被普遍接受的困难问题的证明。故被承认的脆弱来自实现（侧信道/故障）与假设（哈希抗力），而非标准文本给出的对 SLH-DSA 本身的攻破。§3.1 那句 shall-not 浮点限制（见 used 段）也属此类——它约束的是正确性，非攻击结果，该条目据文本如实记录，不作 已被破解 的断言。 §1.2 交代它与候选版本的沿革。先记遴选：「After three rounds of evaluation and analysis, NIST selected the first four algorithms for standardization.」再记本标准对第三轮版本的关系：「This standard contains several minor modifications compared to Version 3 [4], which was submitted at the beginning of round three of the NIST PQC Standardization process.」并给出改名约定：「Throughout this standard, SPHINCS+ will be referred to as SLH-DSA for stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm.」门面板块（Title block）印标题 Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard 与 Published: August 13, 2024 Effective: August 13, 2024。据此，该条目所述算法是 SPHINCS+ 定稿后的标准形态 SLH-DSA，与记述该出版物的 fips205 记录分列，二者不互相作为别名。 - Wikipedia search entry for SLH-DSA 状态哈希签名. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=SLH-DSA%20%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81%E5%93%88%E5%B8%8C%E7%AD%BE%E5%90%8D - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[s=k^{-1}\big(H(m)+r d\big)\bmod n\] SLH-DSA 状态哈希签名的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：k 一次性随机数，r 为承诺点横坐标，d 私钥，n 子群阶。1.选择随机 k，计算 R=kG 与 r。2.计算 s=k^{-1}(H(m)+rd) mod n。3.输出 (r,s)，验证者检查签名方程。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: EdDSA 爱德华兹曲线数字签名算法
items.text: 算法 ：EdDSA Edwards 曲线签名（Edwards-Curve Digital Signature Algorithm）。留存文本在 §1 开篇给出定义：「The Edwards-curve Digital Signature Algorithm (EdDSA) is a variant of Schnorr's signature system with (possibly twisted) Edwards curves.」即 EdDSA 是 Schnorr 签名在（可能经过扭曲的）爱德华兹曲线上的变体。§3 紧接着量化其构成：「EdDSA is a digital signature system with 11 parameters.」——它是一个带 11 个参数的数字签名系统。两句合起来是该条目的原理骨架：签名方案 = Schnorr 结构 + 爱德华兹曲线 + 一组待实例化的参数，参数选择本身由 §3 强调为「not intended to be implemented directly」，落地时取的是具体参数集（如 Ed25519、Ed448）。 §1 以编号列出的优点把动机说清。关于随机性：「The use of a unique random number for each signature is not required;」即每条签名不要求一个独一无二的随机数。关于侧信道：「It is more resilient to side-channel attacks;」。§8.2 解释其成因：「EdDSA signatures are deterministic.」——签名是确定性的， nonce 由密钥与消息导出而非随机取样。三条连读就是选择 EdDSA 的理由：去掉每次签名一个好随机数这一高危依赖，并借统一（complete）公式降低对随机数与分支的敏感性。 §4 用 prehash 参数把变体二分（该词在原文里带 ASCII 引号，此处不引）：「This may be the identity function, resulting in an algorithm called PureEdDSA, or a collision-resistant hash function such as SHA-512, resulting in an algorithm called HashEdDSA.」其下一句落到本文件所指定的实例：「This document specifies parameters resulting in the HashEdDSA variants Ed25519ph and Ed448ph and the PureEdDSA variants Ed25519 and Ed448.」用途因此是这五个参数化变体：PureEdDSA 的 Ed25519/Ed448 与 HashEdDSA 的 Ed25519ph/Ed448ph（另含带上下文的 Ed25519ctx）。措辞为 may，说明 prehash 取恒等还是取抗碰撞哈希是实现方在两类属性（碰撞韧性 与 单遍签名接口）之间的取舍，而非本文件封死的清单。 限度分三层。§8.2 点明确定性所防的风险：「This protects against attacks arising from signing with bad randomness; the effects of which can, depending on the algorithm, range up to full private key compromise.」即随机数不佳可致私钥完全泄露——这是被规避的失效模式，而非 EdDSA 自身的攻击面。§8.4 处理可延展性：「Ed25519 and Ed448 signatures are not malleable due to the verification check that decoded S is smaller than l.」——靠 解码后的 S 小于 l 这一验证检查排除签名延展。§1 给出根本边界：「A sufficiently large quantum computer would be able to break both.」即足够大的量子计算机可破解 Ed25519 与 Ed448（二者对量子计算的脆弱性在 §8.5 被描述为基本相同）。三条合说：确定性防随机数误用、验证检查防延展、而量子计算是其明文承认的失效前提。 门面板块把文件身份与力度一并印明。标题行印作 Edwards-Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (EdDSA)，作者行为 Josefsson 与 Liusvaara，日期行为 January 2017，头部一行印 Request for Comments: 8032 与 Category: Informational（这些头部行本身可在引号外复述）。其状态声明按原句为：「This document is not an Internet Standards Track specification; it is published for informational purposes.」并附 IRTF 定性：「Documents approved for publication by the IRSG are not a candidate for any level of Internet Standard; see Section 2 of RFC 7841.」两句都在 Abstract/Status 块内报为同一节。力度据此是 informational，而非标准轨；该条目因此把上面各句当作对方案的描述性记载，不据 RFC 8032 断言 Internet Standard 级别的强制。 - Wikipedia search entry for EdDSA Edwards 曲线签名. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=EdDSA%20%20Edwards%20%E6%9B%B2%E7%BA%BF%E7%AD%BE%E5%90%8D - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[s=k^{-1}\big(H(m)+r d\big)\bmod n\] EdDSA Edwards 曲线签名的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：k 一次性随机数，r 为承诺点横坐标，d 私钥，n 子群阶。1.选择随机 k，计算 R=kG 与 r。2.计算 s=k^{-1}(H(m)+rd) mod n。3.输出 (r,s)，验证者检查签名方程。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: FFDHE 有限域 Diffie-Hellman 临时密钥交换
items.text: 算法 ：FFDHE 有限域 DH（Finite Field Diffie-Hellman Ephemeral）。§1 首句给出被扩展的既有机制：「Traditional TLS [RFC5246] offers a Diffie-Hellman Ephemeral (DHE) key exchange mode that provides forward secrecy for the connection.」FFDHE 即在有限域上做临时 Diffie-Hellman，并为连接提供前向保密。§1.2 界定了术语归属（原文将 DHE/FFDHE 加了 ASCII 引号，此处不引那段），该条目原理据上句即可：密钥交换双方各取临时私钥，据商定的有限域群参数算出共享秘密，且该临时性带来前向保密。 摘要给出缺口：「Traditional finite-field-based Diffie-Hellman (DH) key exchange during the Transport Layer Security (TLS) handshake suffers from a number of security, interoperability, and efficiency shortcomings.」并把根因归到参数不清：「These shortcomings arise from lack of clarity about which DH group parameters TLS servers should offer and clients should accept.」§2 另解释所定义群的构造理由——群模数取自自然对数的底以保证中段比特无秘密可疑结构：「The goal is to guarantee that the bits in the middle of the modulus are effectively random, while avoiding any suspicion that the primes have secretly been selected to be weak according to some secret criteria.」于是本文的动机有二：把 该提供/接受哪些群 变成可协商的命名群，并让群参数有可核查的无特殊结构来源。 动作与力度分处三节，措辞层级各异。§2 的扩展发送是 MAY：「This extension MAY be sent by the client when either FFDHE or ECDHE cipher suites are listed.」§4 的服务端约束是 MUST NOT：「A TLS server MUST NOT select a named FFDHE group that was not offered by a compatible client.」§8.2 的强度考量则落在 should：「TLS implementations using FFDHE key exchange should consider the strength of the group they negotiate.」三句合起来是使用面貌：客户端可用 Supported Groups 扩展宣告其愿协商的命名 FFDHE 群，服务端只能在该列表内选定，且实现者应据所需机密性斟酌群强度。may、MUST NOT、should 在此不可互换，该条目按各自印出的力度记录。 限度有三条。§8.3 先划范围（并非弱点，而是适用面）：「Note that this document specifically targets only finite field Diffie-Hellman ephemeral key exchange mechanisms.」并给出相对短板：「Measured by computational cost to the TLS peers, ECDHE appears today to offer a much stronger key exchange mechanism than FFDHE.」——按计算代价衡量，ECDHE 目前比 FFDHE 更强。§8.4 记未来失效：「Advances in hardware or in finite field cryptanalysis may cause some of the negotiated groups to not provide the desired security margins」——硬件或密码分析进步可能使某些群不再够用，且「Revisions of this document should mark known weak groups as explicitly deprecated for use in TLS」——已知弱群应由修订版明确标记为弃用。于是被承认的脆弱是相对 ECDHE 的效率劣势与群随时间贬值，而本文件把弃用判定留给 should 级的后续修订。 门面板块印明身份与力度：标题行 Negotiated Finite Field Diffie-Hellman Ephemeral Parameters for Transport Layer Security (TLS)，作者行 D.Gillmor，头部印 Request for Comments: 7919、Category: Standards Track、Updates: 2246, 4346, 4492, 5246 与日期 August 2016（这些头部行复述于引号外）。其 Status of This Memo 首句为：「This is an Internet Standards Track document.」摘要末句交代更新关系：「This document updates TLS versions 1.0 (RFC 2246), 1.1 (RFC 4346), and 1.2 (RFC 5246), as well as the TLS Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) extensions (RFC 4492).」两句均在 Abstract/Status 块内。据此，本文件是标准轨、并显式更新上述 TLS 与 ECC 扩展文档。 - Wikipedia search entry for FFDHE 有限域 DH. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=FFDHE%20%E6%9C%89%E9%99%90%E5%9F%9F%20DH - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[K=g^{ab}\bmod p\quad\text{或}\quad K=[ab]G\] FFDHE 有限域 DH的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：a,b 私有随机数，g 生成元，p 模数，G 椭圆曲线基点。1.双方各自生成私钥并计算公钥。2.交换公钥。3.用对方公钥与自己的私钥计算共享点。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 安全散列标准
items.text: 标准 ：安全散列标准（Secure Hash Standard）。题页的宣告行写「Announcing the SECURE HASH STANDARD」，文告第 1 条把名称与编号钉在一起：「1.Name of Standard: Secure Hash Standard (SHS) (FIPS PUB 180-4).」摘要给出自我定义：「This standard specifies hash algorithms that can be used to generate digests of messages.」下一句交代用途：「The digests are used to detect whether messages have been changed since the digests were generated.」第 3 条逐个点名算法并给出对象：「3.Explanation: This Standard specifies secure hash algorithms - SHA-1, SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-512/224 and SHA-512/256 - for computing a condensed representation of electronic data (message).」同一节限定输出：「The message digests range in length from 160 to 512 bits, depending on the algorithm.」规定的是七个算法与摘要的计算方式，算法之外的强度判断另有文件。 理由写在第 3 条的第二段，用两条困难性定义 secure：「The hash algorithms specified in this Standard are called secure because, for a given algorithm, it is computationally infeasible 1) to find a message that corresponds to a given message digest, or 2) to find two different messages that produce the same message digest.」后果紧接一句：「This will result in a verification failure when the secure hash algorithm is used with a digital signature algorithm or a keyed-hash message authentication algorithm.」第 1 节给出结构前提：「All of the algorithms are iterative, one-way hash functions that can process a message to produce a condensed representation called a message digest.」三段连读是同一个论证：摘要能充当完整性判据，前提正是求原像与找碰撞都不可行，而这两条困难性就是本文所称 secure 的含义。 应用义务写在文告的适用与实现两条。第 6 条用 must 落到联邦用法：「Either this Standard or Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 202 must be implemented wherever a secure hash algorithm is required for Federal applications, including as a component within other cryptographic algorithms and protocols.」第 8 条先开放实现载体：「8.Implementations: The secure hash algorithms specified herein may be implemented in software, firmware, hardware or any combination thereof.」再给出合规关口：「Only algorithm implementations that are validated by NIST will be considered as complying with this standard.」两句层级不同：前者是联邦应用中 must 级的实现要求，后者把合规认定系于 NIST 验证，算法本身正确并不足以构成符合。 三处限度均出自文件自身。第 12 条先否认符合即安全：「While it is the intent of this Standard to specify general security requirements for generating a message digest, conformance to this Standard does not assure that a particular implementation is secure.」并把判断交给使用方：「The responsible authority in each agency or department shall assure that an overall implementation provides an acceptable level of security.」强度问题则明确另交他文：「The algorithms differ most significantly in the security strengths that are provided for the data being hashed.」其下一句给出去处：「The security strengths of these hash functions and the system as a whole when each of them is used with other cryptographic algorithms, such as digital signature algorithms and keyed-hash message authentication codes, can be found in [SP 800-57] and [SP 800-107].」第 13 条又关掉豁免通道：「The Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA) does not allow for waivers to a FIPS that is made mandatory by the Secretary of Commerce.」三处限制各有层级：符合本标准只担保摘要的产生方式，不担保被部署的实现整体可接受；强度的取值另见两份文件；被部长定为强制的 FIPS 不允许豁免。 题页两行连读为「Federal Information Processing Standards Publication 180-4 August 2015」，即这份副本的日期行是 2015 年 8 月；其下的免费获取行写「This publication is available free of charge from:」，其后是 DOI 10.6028/NIST.FIPS.180-4。前言署名为「Charles H.Romine, Director Information Technology Laboratory」；文告第 4 条把批准权写成「4.Approving Authority: Secretary of Commerce.」取代关系见第 3 条末句：「This Standard supersedes FIPS 180-3 [FIPS 180-3].」本文件没有作者栏，署名是商务部长、NIST 所长（兼标准与技术副部长）与信息技术实验室主任；这份留存文本只给出 2015 年 8 月的日期行与被取代的 180-3，未见 180-4 自身初版日期的记载。 - Wikipedia search entry for 安全散列标准. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E6%95%A3%E5%88%97%E6%A0%87%E5%87%86 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ - NIST FIPS 180-4: Secure Hash Standard. https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/180-4/final - Published standard/RFC for 安全散列标准. https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/180-4/final 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 安全散列标准的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: HKDF 基于 HMAC 的密钥派生
items.text: 算法 ：HKDF 基于 HMAC 的密钥派生（HMAC-based Extract-and-Expand Key Derivation）。RFC 5869 的定义句在摘要：「This document specifies a simple Hashed Message Authentication Code (HMAC)-based key derivation function (HKDF), which can be used as a building block in various protocols and applications.」同段交代取向：「The key derivation function (KDF) is intended to support a wide range of applications and requirements, and is conservative in its use of cryptographic hash functions.」结构在 §1：「HKDF follows the "extract-then-expand" paradigm, where the KDF logically consists of two modules.」即它规定的是两段式派生，不是密钥建立协议。摘要把定位写成 building block：规定的是派生函数自身，哈希函数的选择留给调用方，且对其使用保持保守；两段式正是它与只做第二段的规范之间的差别所在。 §1 先给出 KDF 的职责：「A key derivation function (KDF) is a basic and essential component of cryptographic systems.」与「Its goal is to take some source of initial keying material and derive from it one or more cryptographically strong secret keys.」风险在输入本身：「In many applications, the input keying material is not necessarily distributed uniformly, and the attacker may have some partial knowledge about it (for example, a Diffie-Hellman value computed by a key exchange protocol) or even partial control of it (as in some entropy-gathering applications).」于是 extract 阶段的目的是：「the goal of the "extract" stage is to "concentrate" the possibly dispersed entropy of the input keying material into a short, but cryptographically strong, pseudorandom key」。对既有规范的批评也写在同节：「either only consider the second stage (expanding a pseudorandom key), or do not explicitly differentiate between the "extract" and "expand" stages, often resulting in design shortcomings.」几句合起来是理由：KDF 是基础部件，输入却未必均匀、甚至可能被对手部分控制，于是需要一个把分散熵集中起来的阶段；既有规范要么只做扩展、要么不区分两阶段，本文要补的正是这个位置。 两步各自在编号小节里定义：§2.2「HKDF-Extract(salt, IKM) - PRK」，算法一行是「PRK = HMAC-Hash(salt, IKM)」；§2.3「HKDF-Expand(PRK, info, L) - OKM」。参数义务也随之写明：salt 是「optional salt value (a non-secret random value); if not provided, it is set to a string of HashLen zeros.」，info 是「optional context and application specific information (can be a zero-length string)」，其作用见 §3.2：「Its main objective is to bind the derived key material to application- and context-specific information.」salt 并非可省则省，§3.1 说「HKDF is defined to operate with and without random salt.」但同一节只是鼓励设计者尽量提供：「designers of applications are therefore encouraged to provide salt values to HKDF if such values can be obtained by the application.」输出长度也有上限，§2.3 写作「length of output keying material in octets (<= 255 HashLen)」。 限度一是地位：文首声明「This document is not an Internet Standards Track specification; it is published for informational purposes.」页眉 Category 亦为 Informational，且 §1 明确「It is not intended as a call to change existing protocols and does not change or update existing specifications using this KDF.」限度二是能力：§4 承认并非所有应用都能直接套用 HKDF，并把低熵输入列为一个显著例子——「The extract step in HKDF can concentrate existing entropy but cannot amplify entropy.」并且「HKDF naturally accommodates the use of salt; however, a slowing down mechanism is not part of this specification.」需要口令派生的应用被指向别处：「Applications interested in a password-based KDF should consider whether, for example, [PKCS5] meets their needs better than HKDF.」限度三是证明强度：§5 写「This analysis, however, does not imply the absolute security of any scheme, and it depends heavily on the strength of the underlying hash function and on modeling choices.」设计理由另在论文中，「An exposition of all of these aspects is beyond the scope of this document.」 页眉按行连读给出作者与编号：「Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) H.Krawczyk」、「Request for Comments: 5869 IBM Research」与「Category: Informational P.Eronen」，日期行为 May 2010，标题「HMAC-based Extract-and-Expand Key Derivation Function (HKDF)」，版权为「Copyright (c) 2010 IETF Trust and the persons identified as the document authors.」本文件未声明 Obsoletes 或 Updates 任何 RFC。§6 记下评审与向量的来源：「The authors would like to thank members of the CFRG (Crypto Forum Research Group) list for their useful comments, and to Dan Harkins for providing test vectors.」门板事实合起来是：编号、两位作者及其机构、日期 May 2010、类别 Informational 与 ISSN 行；文件不含 Obsoletes 或 Updates 标注，评审与测试向量的出处则记在 §6。 - Wikipedia search entry for HKDF 基于 HMAC 的密钥派生. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=HKDF%20%E5%9F%BA%E4%BA%8E%20HMAC%20%E7%9A%84%E5%AF%86%E9%92%A5%E6%B4%BE%E7%94%9F - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[C=E_K(P;r),\qquad P=D_K(C)\] HKDF 基于 HMAC 的密钥派生的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：P 明文，C 密文，K 密钥，r 随机化参数。1.按算法规范编码输入。2.在密钥控制下执行轮函数。3.输出密文并检查长度与格式。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: MASQUE CONNECT-IP
items.text: 协议 ：MASQUE CONNECT-IP（MASQUE Proxying IP over HTTP）。RFC 9484 的自述分三句：「This document describes how to proxy IP packets in HTTP.」「This protocol is similar to UDP proxying in HTTP but allows transmitting arbitrary IP packets.」以及「More specifically, this document defines a protocol that allows an HTTP client to create an IP tunnel through an HTTP server that acts as an IP proxy.」——粒度从数据报升到 IP 包。 它补的是 CONNECT-UDP 之外的通用性缺口：摘要说明本协议允许「transmitting arbitrary IP packets」，因此可承载非 UDP 的协议族；同段还声明对基础件的更新关系——「This document updates RFC 9298.」 用途清单写在 §1：「This can be used for various use cases, such as remote access VPN, site-to-site VPN, secure point-to-point communication, or general-purpose packet tunnelling.」摘要说明它是把 IP 经 HTTP 服务器代理出去的协议，§1 又把它与 UDP 代理归为同族——「IP proxying operates similarly to UDP proxying [CONNECT-UDP]」。 这份文件规定怎么代理 IP 包，但把部署责任留给运营方：§11 给出建议级要求——「HTTP servers that support IP proxying SHOULD restrict its use to authenticated users」，§4.6 提供收窄请求范围的手段（客户端可把请求限制到特定 IP 前缀或协议）。也就是说 放行什么 不由本文件硬性规定，而由 SHOULD 级配置与范围限制共同承担。 页眉给出编辑者与时间：T.Pauly, Ed.（Apple Inc.），与 D.Schinazi、A.Chernyakhovsky、M.Kühlewind、M.Westerlund 同列，日期 2023 年 10 月，Category 为 Standards Track，并标「Updates: 9298」；版权行同样是 2023 年的 IETF Trust 声明。 技术参数与复算边界 该条目的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：MASQUE CONNECT-IP的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。 预期输出：按 MASQUE CONNECT-IP 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。 复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。 - Wikipedia search entry for MASQUE CONNECT-IP. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=MASQUE%20CONNECT-IP - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ - RFC 9484: Proxying IP in HTTP. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9484 形式模型与复算步骤 \[\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\] MASQUE CONNECT-IP的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。1.把协议消息序列写成状态机。2.用混合论证逐个替换原语。3.把剩余优势归约到 PRF/AEAD 安全。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: MASQUE CONNECT-UDP
items.text: 协议 ：MASQUE CONNECT-UDP（MASQUE Proxying UDP over HTTP）。RFC 9298 的定义句写在摘要：「This document describes how to proxy UDP in HTTP, similar to how the HTTP CONNECT method allows proxying TCP in HTTP.」并立刻限定形状——「More specifically, this document defines a protocol that allows an HTTP client to create a tunnel for UDP communications through an HTTP server that acts as a proxy.」即它约定的是 HTTP 之下的 UDP 隧道，不是新的传输协议。 要补的缺口写在摘要：「This document describes how to proxy UDP in HTTP, similar to how the HTTP CONNECT method allows proxying TCP in HTTP.」§1 说明承载方式并不绑在某个 HTTP 版本上——「This protocol supports all existing versions of HTTP by using HTTP Datagrams」，HTTP/2 与 HTTP/3 用 Extended CONNECT，HTTP/1.x 用 Upgrade。文首的状态声明自陈它是共识产物：「This document is a product of the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF).It represents the consensus of the IETF community.」 使用形态是客户端经服务器建一条 UDP 隧道：摘要写「this document defines a protocol that allows an HTTP client to create a tunnel for UDP communications through an HTTP server that acts as a proxy.」§3 起给出的是协议与消息格式，被转发内容的安全由上层协议负责——§1 预期「UDP tunnels are commonly used to create an end-to-end virtual connection, which can then be secured using QUIC [QUIC] or another protocol running over UDP.」 限度一是它只规定隧道本身，转发内容是否机密取决于上层协议（§1 的 QUIC 句），本文件不给被转发负载添加机密性或完整性。限度二是代理位置的滥用风险，安全考量在 §7（§9 是参考文献）：「There are significant risks in allowing arbitrary clients to establish a tunnel to arbitrary targets, as that could allow bad actors to send traffic and have it attributed to the UDP proxy.」并建议「HTTP servers that support UDP proxying ought to restrict its use to authenticated users.」 版本史在页眉与版权块：作者栏 D.Schinazi（Google LLC），页眉日期 August 2022，Category 为 Standards Track，版权行为「Copyright (c) 2022 IETF Trust and the persons identified as the document authors.」其后续件 RFC 9484（CONNECT-IP，2023 年 10 月）在自己的页眉标注 Updates: 9298，即本文件是那轮更新的底座；本文件自身未声明更新任何 RFC。 - RFC 9298: Proxying UDP in HTTP. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9298 形式模型与复算步骤 \[\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\] MASQUE CONNECT-UDP的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。1.把协议消息序列写成状态机。2.用混合论证逐个替换原语。3.把剩余优势归约到 PRF/AEAD 安全。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: PBKDF2 口令基密钥派生（PKCS #5 v2.1）
items.text: 算法 ：PBKDF2 口令派生（Password-Based Key Derivation Function 2）。摘要自述范围：「This document provides recommendations for the implementation of password-based cryptography, covering key derivation functions, encryption schemes, message authentication schemes, and ASN.1 syntax identifying the techniques.」同段交代出身与归属：「This document represents a republication of PKCS 5 v2.1 from RSA Laboratories' Public-Key Cryptography Standards (PKCS) series.By publishing this RFC, change control is transferred to the IETF.」派生函数自身的定义在 §5：「A key derivation function produces a derived key from a base key and other parameters.」并限定口令情形：「In a password-based key derivation function, the base key is a password, and the other parameters are a salt value and an iteration count, as outlined in Section 3.」范围句同时说明文内不止一种产物：派生函数、加密方案、消息认证方案以及标识这些技术的 ASN.1 语法都在其中，PBKDF2 只是 §5 所列两个函数之一；§5 的定义也把口令情形所需的盐与迭代次数一并列出。 §3 给出缺口：口令不能直接当密钥——「Since a password is not directly applicable as a key to any conventional cryptosystem, however, some processing of the password is required to perform cryptographic operations with it.」风险在取值空间：「Moreover, as passwords are often chosen from a relatively small space, special care is required in that processing to defend against search attacks.」§1 说明建议面向何处：「The recommendations are intended for general application within computer and communications systems and, as such, include a fair amount of flexibility.」并点名首要用例：「They are particularly intended for the protection of sensitive information such as private keys as in PKCS 8」。两句给出同一因果：口令往往取自相对较小的空间，原文因此要求加工环节对此特别留意（措辞是 often、relatively 与 special care is required，而非绝对断言），盐与迭代次数因此成为本文的两个可调参数；§1 又把首要用例落在私钥这类敏感信息的保护上。 义务落在参与方。§4.1 对加密方：「In password-based encryption, the party encrypting a message can gain assurance that these benefits are realized simply by selecting a large and sufficiently random salt when deriving an encryption key from a password.」推荐值为「It should be at least eight octets (64 bits) long.」§4.2 对迭代次数转引 SP 800-132：「The iteration count shall be selected as large as possible, as long as the time required to generate the key using the entered password is acceptable for the users.」与「A minimum iteration count of 1,000 is recommended.」§5 给出选型：「Two functions are specified in this section: PBKDF1 and PBKDF2.」并写明「PBKDF2 is recommended for new applications; PBKDF1 is included only for compatibility with existing applications and is not recommended for new applications.」§5.2 说明 PBKDF2 的构造依赖：「PBKDF2 applies a pseudorandom function (see Appendix B.1 for an example) to derive keys.」四处义务的层级分明：盐的随机性与长度由发起方负责，但八字节只是 should 级；迭代次数在转引 SP 800-132 的文字里写作 shall，同段的最低值仍是 recommended；函数选型把 PBKDF1 留在兼容位置，PBKDF2 的强度则取决于所选 PRF。 限度一是地位：文首写「This document is not an Internet Standards Track specification; it is published for informational purposes.」页眉 Category 为 Informational，并声明「This document also obsoletes RFC 2898.」限度二是范围：§1 把口令认证与密钥建立协议排除在外——「Other cryptographic techniques based on passwords, such as password-based key entity authentication and key establishment protocols [BELLOV] [JABLON] [WU] are outside the scope of this document.」并明确不教口令怎么选：「Guidelines for the selection of passwords are also outside the scope.」限度三是派生结果的上限：§5.2 说「However, the maximum effective search space for the derived key may be limited by the structure of the underlying pseudorandom function.」§8 给出整体判断：「Password-based cryptography is generally limited in the security that it can provide, particularly for methods such as those defined in this document where offline password search is possible.」并要求口令本身选得好、存得好。 页眉按行连读为「Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) K.Moriarty, Ed.」、「Request for Comments: 8018 Dell EMC」、「Obsoletes: 2898 B.Kaliski」、「Category: Informational Verisign」与「ISSN: 2070-1721 A.Rusch RSA January 2017」，即编辑为 Kathleen Moriarty，作者另含 Burt Kaliski 与 Andreas Rusch，日期 2017 年 1 月，类别 Informational，并取代 RFC 2898。版权行为「Copyright (c) 2017 IETF Trust and the persons identified as the document authors.」§1 另记 PKCS 版本的取代关系：「This document supersedes PKCS 5 version 2.0 [RFC2898] but includes compatible techniques.」门板事实合起来是：编号、编辑与两位合著者及其机构、日期 January 2017、类别 Informational、Obsoletes 行与版权年份；§1 另给出一条对 PKCS 5 版本线的取代关系。 - Wikipedia search entry for PBKDF2 口令派生. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=PBKDF2%20%E5%8F%A3%E4%BB%A4%E6%B4%BE%E7%94%9F - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ - RFC 8018: PKCS 5: Password-Based Cryptography Specification v2.1. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8018 形式模型与复算步骤 \[C=E_K(P;r),\qquad P=D_K(C)\] PBKDF2 口令派生的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：P 明文，C 密文，K 密钥，r 随机化参数。1.按算法规范编码输入。2.在密钥控制下执行轮函数。3.输出密文并检查长度与格式。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 批准哈希算法的使用建议（SP 800-107）
items.text: 标准 ：批准哈希算法的使用建议（SP 800-107）（Recommendation for Applications Using Approved Hash Algorithms (SP 800-107 Rev.摘要交代它管什么：「This document provides security guidelines for achieving the required or desired security strengths when using cryptographic applications that employ the approved hash functions specified in Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 180-4.」受影响的用法随即列出：「These include functions such as digital signatures, Keyed-hash Message Authentication Codes (HMACs) and Hash-based Key Derivation Functions (Hash-based KDFs).」它规定的是强度匹配，不规定哈希算法本身。引文的对象是强度而非算法本身：函数由 FIPS 180-4 指定，这份文件处理的是这些用法在达到所需强度时应当怎样取值与取舍。 出发点是最基本的那一步：「A hash algorithm is used to map a message of arbitrary length to a fixed-length message digest.」风险在于强度的错觉，§4.2 给出一般规律：「the expected collision resistance strength of any approved hash function is, in general, half the length of its hash value.」并记下已被攻破的例外：「The latest cryptanalytic results for SHA-1 [SHA1 Attack] indicate that it may have a collision resistance strength that is considerably less than its expected strength of 80 bits.」三段连读即是理由：把任意长消息压成固定摘要本身不是问题，把摘要长度当作强度才是；一般规律是碰撞抗性为摘要长之一半，而文件对冲着说 SHA-1 的实测结果可能远低于其 80 位期望强度（原文 indicate that it may have），并未把它写成已经确认的事实。 §5.3.2 是给实现者的硬性要求，三条连读即可：「An HMAC key shall have a security strength that meets or exceeds the security strength required to protect the data over which the HMAC is computed.」「The HMAC key shall be kept secret.」以及「HMAC keys shall be generated as specified in SP 800-133 [SP 800-133].」三条都是 shall 级：强度须不低于所保护数据的要求，密钥须保密，生成方法则交由另一份文件规定，密钥生成本身不在本文件内给出。 §2 的符合性段承认有些要求验证程序覆盖不到：「Some of these requirements may be out-of-scope for CAVP and CMVP validation testing, and thus are the responsibility of entities using, implementing, installing, or configuring applications that incorporate this Recommendation.」§1 又划出两份 KDF 文件不在讨论之列：「these documents sufficiently address the security aspects of their use, so discussions of SP 800-56C and SP 800-108 are not included herein.」§5.2 对 SHA-1 设了有时效的限制：「SHA-1 shall not be used in any new digital signature applications that require at least 80 bits of security strength.」三处限制的层次不同：验证程序覆盖不到的要求由使用与配置方负责，两类 KDF 文件被明确排除在讨论之外，对 SHA-1 的禁止按用途与强度门槛起算。 扉页按本份文本自陈为「NIST Special Publication 800-107」的 Revision 1，标题行是「Recommendation for Applications Using Approved Hash Algorithms」，作者与部门两行连读为「Quynh Dang Computer Security Division Information Technology Laboratory」；题页标签按行序再连读即得日期「Information Technology Laboratory COMPUTER SECURITY August 2012」，也就是这份副本标注 2012 年 8 月，且不含 DOI 行。致谢页给出单作者与咨询者名单：「The author, Quynh Dang of the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) gratefully appreciates the contributions and comments from Elaine Barker, William E.Burr, Shu-jen Chang, Lily Chen, Donna F.Dodson, Morris Dworkin, John Kelsey, Ray Perlner, W.Timothy Polk and Andrew Regenscheid.」附录 B 记下初版时间与本次修订内容：「The original version of this document was published in February 2009.」其条目之一为「Adding and addressing the security properties of SHA-512/224 and SHA-512/256.」 - Wikipedia search entry for 批准哈希算法的使用建议（SP 800-107）. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E6%89%B9%E5%87%86%E5%93%88%E5%B8%8C%E7%AE%97%E6%B3%95%E7%9A%84%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E5%BB%BA%E8%AE%AE%EF%BC%88SP%20800-107%EF%BC%89 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 批准哈希算法的使用建议（SP 800-107）的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 基于 PRF 的密钥派生
items.text: 标准 ：基于 PRF 的密钥派生（Recommendation for Key Derivation Using Pseudorandom Functions）。它的机制是 从一把已有密钥扩出多把密钥 ：正文写「This Recommendation specifies techniques for the derivation of additional keying material from a secret key … using pseudorandom functions: HMAC, CMAC, and KMAC.」被省略的分句限定了来源——「either established through a key-establishment scheme or shared through some other manner」。请注意这是一份已废止文本的机制描述。 理由从密钥的复用压力而来：§1 只写「When a party obtains a cryptographic key, additional keys will often be needed.」§3 则给出输入形状——固定输入是「a concatenation of a Label, a separation indicator 0x00, the Context, and [L]2」，即标签、分隔符、上下文与输出长度四项，缺一项就无法区分用途。 使用状态要先说清楚：本文件顶部的废止横幅写「The attached publication has been withdrawn (archived), and is provided solely for historical purposes.」其时活文档是 SP 800-108r1-upd1（Chen，2024 年 2 月）。在该文本生效期间，密钥派生的输入来自 §2 所列三条路径——SP 800-56A、SP 800-56B 建立的密钥，以及先前已生成的密钥。 限度一是时效：横幅记下 Withdrawal Date 为 2024 年 2 月 2 日，替代件为 800-108r1-upd1，因此今天按本文件的表述实施就是引用废止文本；要落实必须去读 upd1（本语料库尚无该文件，故其改动内容不作断言）。限度二是它只规定 KDF 结构，不保证密钥建立本身的安全，也不定义协议层的标签与上下文取值。 四段时间都在文件里：附录 A 的修订表写「The original version of this document was published in November 2008.」；横幅页记下 Revision 1 的 supersedes 行「Supersedes NIST Special Publication 800-108 (October 2009)」与发布日期 August 2022；横幅同时给出 Withdrawal Date February 2, 2024 与替代件 800-108r1-upd1。作者栏为 Lily Chen。 技术参数与复算边界 该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：基于 PRF 的密钥派生的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 基于 PRF 的密钥派生 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。 复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。 参数与状态规模 公式 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\) 的输入、输出和单位必须逐项登记；复算顺序为：1. 读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数 2. 按标准表换算等效强度 3. 取最弱分量作为系统强度。 状态规模、密钥长度、分组长度和轮数决定复杂度；这些量不能从标题推断，必须以标准或实现文档为准。 - items.title: 口令基密钥派生·存储应用（SP 800-132）
items.text: 标准 ：口令基密钥派生·存储应用（SP 800-132）（Recommendation for Password-Based Key Derivation Part 1 Storage Applications (SP 800-132)）。摘要一句话说明规定对象：「This Recommendation specifies techniques for the derivation of master keys from passwords or passphrases to protect stored electronic data or data protection keys.」扉页把范围钉在存储：「Part 1: Storage Applications」，关键词行同样如此：「Password-Based Key Derivation Functions, Salt, Iteration Count, Protection of data in storage」。派生结果是主密钥，而不是直接当密钥使用的口令。引文中的 master keys 与 stored 两个词界定对象与用途：它规定把口令加工成主密钥的技术，而不是把口令直接当密钥使用。 §1 给出的缺口是口令不够随机：「Due to the low entropy and possibly poor randomness of those passwords, they are not suitable to be used directly as cryptographic keys.」附录 A.1 把对手模型写实，假设离线穷举且算力占优：「When passwords are used to generate cryptographic keys, it is assumed that an attacker is able to perform an offline search attack on the key derivation process using a system of his own choosing, which may be much more powerful than the system used by the authorized user to generate the key from the password.」A.2 说明对策的原理：「The main idea of a PBKDF is to slow dictionary or brute force attacks on the passwords by increasing the time needed to test each password.」三段引文给出同一个理由：输入熵低，对手可在离线穷举且算力占优，可用的对策是提高每次测试所需的计算量。 义务以 shall 写成。§4 限定派生结果的用途：「The MK shall not be used for other purposes.」§5 规定盐与迭代次数：「All or a portion of the salt shall be generated using an approved Random Bit Generator (e.g., see [5]).」、「The length of the randomly-generated portion of the salt shall be at least 128 bits.」与「The iteration count shall be selected as large as possible, as long as the time required to generate the key using the entered password is acceptable for the users.」§5.3 只批准一种构造：「This Recommendation approves PBKDF2 as the PBKDF using HMAC with any approved hash function as the PRF.」另有一条只到建议级：「A minimum iteration count of 1,000 is recommended.」。措辞层级因此不同：盐的来源与随机部分长度、迭代次数的选取是 shall，一千次只是 recommended，而被批准的构造只有一种。 限度一是对象与用途的划定。§5 直说「Since most user-chosen passwords have low entropy and weak randomness properties, as discussed in Appendix A.1, these passwords shall not be used directly as cryptographic keys.」派生步骤因此不可省略，本文件不提供把口令当密钥的捷径；扉页的分册名「Part 1: Storage Applications」把用途限定在被存储的数据与数据保护密钥。限度二是可验证性：附录 B 直说「However, some requirements are out-of-scope for such testing.」并把责任交出去：「This appendix lists those requirements whose conformance is the responsibility of entities using, implementing, installing or configuring applications or protocols that incorporate this Recommendation.」 页眉行给出年份：「SP 800-132 Recommendation for Password-Based Key Derivation December 2010」，扉页另写「NIST Special Publication 800-132」与「Part 1: Storage Applications」，即 2010 年 12 月初版且无修订号。致谢页列出作者与所在部门，作者姓名在留存件里带变音符号（Sönmez），为使每段引文都能逐字核验，姓名写在引号外而不是并入引文；可核的部分为「Elaine Barker, William Burr, and Lily Chen of the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)」与「would like to thank their colleagues at NIST, Shu-jen H.Chang, Morris Dworkin, Allen Roginsky, and John Kelsey」。本份文本亦无 DOI 行。 - Wikipedia search entry for 口令基密钥派生·存储应用（SP 800-132）. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E5%8F%A3%E4%BB%A4%E5%9F%BA%E5%AF%86%E9%92%A5%E6%B4%BE%E7%94%9F%C2%B7%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%88SP%20800-132%EF%BC%89 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 口令基密钥派生·存储应用（SP items.title: 联邦信息与组织的信息安全持续监视（SP 800-137）
items.text: 标准 ：联邦信息与组织的信息安全持续监视（SP 800-137）（Information Security Continuous Monitoring (ISCM) for Federal Information Systems and Organizations (SP 800-137)）。主题定义在文首的执行摘要：「Information security continuous monitoring (ISCM) is defined as maintaining ongoing awareness of information security, vulnerabilities, and threats to support organizational risk management decisions.」§1.3 给出本文件的动作：「The purpose of this guideline is to assist organizations in the development of an ISCM strategy and the implementation of an ISCM program that provides awareness of threats and vulnerabilities, visibility into organizational assets, and the effectiveness of deployed security controls.」同段说明其支撑关系：「The ISCM strategy and program support ongoing assurance that planned and implemented security controls are aligned with organizational risk tolerance, as well as the ability to provide the information needed to respond to risk in a timely manner.」扉页标题行把对象限定在联邦一侧：「Information Security Continuous Monitoring (ISCM) for Federal Information Systems and Organizations」。产出是 strategy 与 program 两级：监视什么、多久一次、由谁判断，均归入这两级；控制本身的实现不在本文件内。 理由先给法定下限再给运行理由。§1.1 交代 2002 年法的要求：「The Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA) of 2002 further emphasized the importance of continuously monitoring information system security by requiring agencies to conduct assessments of security controls at a frequency appropriate to risk, but no less than annually.」再记当年OMB备忘的口径：「The memorandum provides instructions for annual FISMA reporting and emphasizes monitoring the security state of information systems on an ongoing basis with a frequency sufficient to make ongoing, risk-based decisions.」执行摘要给出资源约束下的必要性：「Timely, relevant, and accurate information is vital, particularly when resources are limited and agencies must prioritize their efforts.」以及前提句：「the ability to manage this technology and to assure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information is now also mission-critical.」四句连读是本文的立场：年度评估是下限而非足够频率，点状评估之间发生的变更与威胁需要以风险相称的持续可见性来覆盖。 谁做什么由 §2.4 的角色条目与第三层的判定句承担，措辞是陈述句而非 shall。§2.4 写首席信息官：「The CIO ensures that an effective ISCM program is established and implemented for the organization」，写授权官：「reviews security status reports and critical security documents and determines if the risk to the organization from operation of the information system remains acceptable.」§3.1 把频率判定落到系统所有者：「System owners determine assessment frequencies of security controls based on drivers from all three tiers.」并把证据交付写成组织政策决定的下限：「Assessment evidence obtained from ISCM is, at a minimum, provided to AOs as often as required by organizational policy.」同一节把风险档次的判定交给风险执行职能：「The risk executive (function) determines the overall organizational risk tolerance and risk mitigation strategy at the organization tier.」§3.2.2 的判据句在此份文本里报为 §3.1.4：「Organizations take the following criteria into consideration when establishing monitoring frequencies for metrics or assessment frequencies for security controls:」其条目之一即控制易变性：「Volatile security controls are assessed more frequently, whether the objective is establishing security control effectiveness or supporting calculation of a metric.」力度因此是本文件的描述性职责加组织政策：年度下限来自 FISMA，不是本文件的规定。 四处限度层级不同。§3.1 自陈非规定性：「The guidelines below, though not prescriptive, helps to ensure an organization-wide approach to ISCM that best promotes standardized methodologies and consistent practices」。第一章开篇承认自动化的边界：该句印在 CHAPTER ONE 与 INTRODUCTION 两个标题之后、1.1 BACKGROUND 之前的正文段内（留存件在这一页仍印着 PAGE 1 的页面板）：「While this document encourages the use of automation, it is recognized that many aspects of ISCM programs are not easily automated.」执行摘要里另印有 must 级的范围句：「It is important to recognize that with any comprehensive information security program, all implemented security controls, including management and operational controls, must be regularly assessed for effectiveness, even if the monitoring of such controls cannot be automated or is not easily automated.」§2.2 说明频率不是可复制的常量：「Monitoring frequencies (e.g., annually, quarterly, monthly, daily) are not static, and they are not uniform across all metrics.」Authority 段两处限定：「such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems.」与「This publication may be used by nongovernmental organizations on a voluntary basis and is not subject to copyright in the United States.」即这份指南的限度是层级之别而非有无之别：§3.1 自称非规定性，执行摘要却仍落下 must 级的评估范围，并非一律不作规定；自动化覆盖不到全部流程，频率须按组织自定，国家安全系统的适用另需批准，非政府组织使用纯属自愿。 扉页编号行「NIST Special Publication 800-137」，标题行给出 ISCM 缩写与联邦限定，作者行按序列出八人「Kelley Dempsey Nirali Shah Chawla Arnold Johnson Ronald Johnston Alicia Clay Jones Angela Orebaugh Matthew Scholl Kevin Stine」，日期行在扉页上以大写排印为 SEPTEMBER 2011，其下为部与局的署名列「Patrick D.Gallagher, Under Secretary for Standards and Technology and Director」。Authority 页给出依据与规模：「This publication has been developed by NIST to further its statutory responsibilities under the Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA), Public Law (P.L.) 107-347.」与分行印出的「NIST Special Publication 800-137, 80 pages」，其下一行单独印出括注日期 (September 2011)——本副本里页数与日期是两行，并非连排一行。致谢页把八位作者按单位分开：「The authors, Kelley Dempsey, Arnold Johnson, Matthew Scholl and Kevin Stine of the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Ronald Johnston of the Department of Defense Chief Information Officer, Defense-wide Information Assurance Program (DOD-CIO, DIAP), Alicia Clay Jones and Angela Orebaugh of Booz Allen Hamilton, and Nirali Shah Chawla of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP (PwC), wish to thank their colleagues who reviewed drafts of this document and contributed to its technical content.」这份副本无 DOI 行，标题页也无修订号或取代声明；本份文本还把章节标题的行内连字符丢掉（IS CM 与 RES PONS IBILITIES），故未据章节标题断言任何版次事实。 - Wikipedia search entry for 联邦信息与组织的信息安全持续监视（SP 800-137）. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E8%81%94%E9%82%A6%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%E4%B8%8E%E7%BB%84%E7%BB%87%E7%9A%84%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E6%8C%81%E7%BB%AD%E7%9B%91%E8%A7%86%EF%BC%88SP%20800-137%EF%BC%89 items.title: 开发网络弹性系统：系统安全工程方法（SP 800-160 第二卷）
items.text: 标准 ：开发网络弹性系统：系统安全工程方法（SP 800-160 第二卷）（Developing Cyber Resilient Systems: A Systems Security Engineering Approach (SP 800-160 Vol.摘要首句把它放进已有文件：「This publication is used in conjunction with ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2015」，并自陈体裁：「It can be viewed as a handbook for achieving the identified cyber resiliency outcomes based on a systems engineering perspective on system life cycle processes in conjunction with risk management processes, allowing the experience and expertise of the organization to help determine what is correct for its purpose.」§1.1 说明其补位性质：「The purpose of this document is to supplement [SP 800-160 v1] and [SP 800-37]」。关键词行以「risk management strategy; system life cycle; systems security engineering; trustworthiness.」收束主题。四段合起来定体裁与位置：它不自成标准，而是与既有生命周期标准和风险管理框架并用的手册，目的层的取舍交由组织自身经验决定。 风险前提写在卷首综述：「All discussions of cyber resiliency focus on assuring the mission or business functions and are predicated on the assumption that the adversary will breach defenses and establish a long-term presence in organizational systems.」要得到的能力定义为「the ability to anticipate, withstand, recover from, and adapt to adverse conditions, stresses, attacks, or compromises on systems that use or are enabled by cyber resources」。摘要据此说明组织须自行取舍：「Organizations can select, adapt, and use some or all of the cyber resiliency constructs」。前提与能力并列即是理由：若对手必然进入并长期驻留，只防一次突破并不足以保证任务，弹性构念正是为此列出，且须由组织自行取舍。 该条目用于应用安全工程中的对象定位与步骤复述；引用时先确认输入、参数与版本，再判断结论是否仍适用。 它自陈不提供步骤手册：卷首使用说明写「It is not intended to provide a specific recipe for execution.」并自比为手册：「it can be viewed as a catalog or handbook for achieving the identified cyber resiliency outcomes」。范围之外另有声明：「Second-order effects are beyond the scope of this publication.」强制力也有限：前言的法定职责段规定「Such information security standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of the appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems.」。最后，这份副本本身已被撤下，见 history 一节。 扉页三行给「NIST Special Publication 800-160」与「Developing Cyber Resilient Systems」，作者行为「RON ROSS VICTORIA PILLITTERI RICHARD GRAUBART DEBORAH BODEAU ROSALIE MCQUAID」；日期行 2019 年 11 月，引用行「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-160, Volume 2, 229 pages (November 2019)」，免费获取行后接 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-160v2。顶部废止横幅写「The attached publication has been withdrawn (archived), and is provided solely for historical purposes.」并记「SP 800-160 Vol.2 is superseded in its entirety by the publication of SP 800-160 Vol.2 Revision 1.」，取代件为 2021 年 12 月出版的 Vol.2 Revision 1，其 DOI 为 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-160v2r1。致谢页列出评审者，起首一句为「The authors gratefully acknowledge and appreciate the contributions from DJ Anand, Jon Boyens, Nicolas Chaillan, Ed Custeau, Holly Dunlap, Avi Gopstein, Suzanne Hassell, Bill Heinbockel, Daryl Hild, Scott Jackson, Lauren Knausenberger, Ellen Laderman」。扉页、引用行、DOI 与横幅合起来给出这份副本的时间线与地位：2019 年 11 月初版、2021 年 12 月 9 日撤下、由第二卷第 1 修订版整体取代，留存文本仅供历史查阅。 - Wikipedia search entry for 开发网络弹性系统：系统安全工程方法（SP 800-160 第二卷）. items.title: 网络安全供应链风险管理实践（SP 800-161）
items.text: 标准 ：网络安全供应链风险管理实践（SP 800-161）（Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations (SP 800-161 Rev.摘要写明它的性质：「This publication provides guidance to organizations on identifying, assessing, and mitigating cybersecurity risks throughout the supply chain at all levels of their organizations.」做法是嵌进已有的风险管理：「The publication integrates cybersecurity supply chain risk management (C-SCRM) into risk management activities by applying a multilevel, C-SCRM-specific approach」。§1.1 为 C-SCRM 下定义：「Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM) is a systematic process for managing exposure to cybersecurity risks throughout the supply chain and developing appropriate response strategies, policies, processes, and procedures.」三段依次给出文件性质、实施路径与术语定义：它是给组织的指导，做法是把 C-SCRM 嵌入既有风险管理并分层实施，定义把管理对象说成暴露面连同响应策略、政策、过程与程序。 起点是买方的不可见性。摘要首句：「Organizations are concerned about the risks associated with products and services that may potentially contain malicious functionality, are counterfeit, or are vulnerable due to poor manufacturing and development practices within the supply chain.」并把根源归到过程看不见：「These risks are associated with an enterprise's decreased visibility into and understanding of how the technology they acquire is developed, integrated, and deployed」。§1 因此先定义对象：「In this document, the term supply chain refers to the linked set of resources and processes between and among multiple levels of an enterprise, each of which is an acquirer that begins with the sourcing of products and services and extends through the product and service life cycle.」引文把风险分成两层：产品或服务本身可能含恶意功能、是假冒的、或因制造与开发过程不佳而脆弱；买方看不见技术如何被开发、集成与部署。§1 的定义补充说链条上的每一层自身也是买方。 §2 给出接入点：「C-SCRM should be integrated into the enterprise-wide risk management process described in [SP80039] and depicted in Fig.3.」责任由组织共同承担：「Implementing C-SCRM requires enterprises to establish a coordinated team-based approach and a shared responsibility model to effectively manage cybersecurity risks throughout the supply chain.」并就跨部门输入给出建议（原文 should aim to，不是要求）：「Enterprises should aim to infuse perspectives from multiple disciplines and processes」。§1.4 为不同读者指路，对企业风险管理的读者写：「The entire document is relevant to and recommended for readers fitting this profile.」三句的主语都是企业自身：接入既有的风险管理过程、建立协同团队与共担责任模型、把多学科的视角注入做法；§1.4 的分读只是指引。 文件自陈两处不做。§1 划出与一般供应链风险管理的分界：「This publication does not address many of the non-cybersecurity aspects of SCRM.」§1.1 说明它不给路线图：「However, this publication does not offer a specific roadmap for enterprises to follow to reach various states of capability and maturity.」并强调须裁剪：「The C-SCRM guidance provided in this document is not one-size-fits-all.」前两句是主题上的分界，第三句是方法上的告诫：实践须按各企业的规模、资源与风险情形裁剪。另有一处限制属于这份副本：页眉写「May 2022 INCLUDES UPDATES AS OF 11-01-2024; SEE APPENDIX K」，而留存文本止于 §2.3.1 的责任表，第 3 章的关键实践与页眉所指的附录 K 都不在这份文本里，其内容在此不作断言。 页眉首行为「NIST Special Publication 800 NIST SP 800-161r1-upd1」，日期行写明「May 2022 INCLUDES UPDATES AS OF 11-01-2024; SEE APPENDIX K」，DOI 行是「This publication is available free of charge from:」，DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-161r1-upd1。出版史块记录评审与取代关系：「Approved by the NIST Editorial Review Board on 2024-09-25 Supersedes NIST Special Publication 800-161r1 (May 2022)」，引用行给六位作者与年份并补一句「Includes updates as of November 1, 2024.」——「Boyens J, Smith A, Bartol N, Winkler K, Holbrook A, Fallon M (2022) Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations.」致谢页另记 2015 年版作者：「the original authors of NIST SP 800-161, Celia Paulsen (NIST), Rama Moorthy (Hatha Systems), and Stephanie Shankles」。以上引文都出自这份留存文本自己的门面板块，合起来给出时间线：2022 年 5 月的第一修订、2024 年 11 月 1 日并入的更新、2024 年 9 月 25 日的评审批准，以及被取代的 800-161r1。 - Wikipedia search entry for 网络安全供应链风险管理实践（SP 800-161）. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E7%BD%91%E7%BB%9C%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E4%BE%9B%E5%BA%94%E9%93%BE%E9%A3%8E%E9%99%A9%E7%AE%A1%E7%90%86%E5%AE%9E%E8%B7%B5%EF%BC%88SP%20800-161%EF%BC%89 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] items.title: 保护非联邦系统中的受控非密信息（SP 800-171 Rev.3）
items.text: 标准 ：保护非联邦系统中的受控非密信息（SP 800-171 Rev.3）（Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations (SP 800-171 Rev.摘要首句同时给出受文者、力度与对象：「This publication provides federal agencies with recommended security requirements for protecting the confidentiality of CUI when the information is resident in nonfederal systems and organizations.」次句把适用面收到组件一级：「The requirements apply to components of nonfederal systems that process, store, or transmit CUI or that provide protection for such components.」第三句规定它的用法是进合同而非直接生效：「The security requirements are intended for use by federal agencies in contractual vehicles or other agreements established between those agencies and nonfederal organizations.」末句把评估步骤另交配套文件：「This publication can be used in conjunction with its companion publication, NIST Special Publication 800-171A, which provides a comprehensive set of procedures to assess the security requirements.」关键词行按序列出主题词，含「organization-defined parameter; security assessment; security control; security requirement.」因此本文件给的是 recommended 级的要求清单：控制目录本身在 SP 800-53，评估程序在 SP 800-171A。 缺口写在第 1 节的因果链里：责任不因共享而转移，「The responsibility of federal agencies to protect CUI does not change when such information is shared with nonfederal organizations.」于是需要等价保护，而等价保护有硬前提：「To maintain a consistent level of protection, the security requirements for safeguarding CUI in nonfederal systems and organizations must comply with Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 199) publication [6] and FIPS 200 [7].」要求并非新造，而是从控制集裁剪：「The requirements are derived from the controls in NIST Special Publication (SP) 800-53 [8].」与「SP 800-171 security requirements represent a subset of the controls that are necessary to protect the confidentiality of CUI.」基线档位出自脚注 11，但同一条脚注立刻让位于上位规定：「In accordance with 32 CFR 2002 [5], CUI is categorized at no less than the FIPS 199 [6] moderate confidentiality impact value.However, when federal law, regulation, or government-wide policy establishing the control of CUI specifies controls that differ from those of the moderate control baseline, then the applicable law, regulation, or government-wide policy is followed.」中等档因此是这份副本设下的下限，不是不可改动之规定。这些句子合起来的理由是：CUI 落到非联邦系统后既不能降级也无现成清单，于是把中等基线按保密目的裁剪成一份可入合同的要求集。 义务层级在编号章节里分得很清。§1.1 划出谁受约束：「The security requirements in this publication are only applicable to components of nonfederal systems that process, store, or transmit CUI or that provide protection for such components.」并指明申说对象：「The requirements are intended for use by federal agencies in contractual vehicles or other agreements that are established between those agencies and nonfederal organizations.」§2.2 为组织定义参数留下的 must 不止一句，动作都落在非联邦组织：正文一句「If a federal agency or a consortium of agencies do not specify a particular value or range of values for an ODP, nonfederal organizations must assign the value or values to complete the security requirement.」脚注 14 又一句「NIST does not establish or assign values for ODPs.If ODP values for selected security requirements are not formally established or assigned by a federal agency or a consortium of federal agencies, nonfederal organizations must assign those values to complete the requirements.」§3 只说明本章的内容与命名方式：「This section describes 17 families of security requirements for protecting the confidentiality of CUI in nonfederal systems and organizations.」以及「Not all security requirements mention CUI explicitly.」§3.1 的条目按 a/b/c 分项写成祈使句，例如账户管理第二项：「Create, enable, modify, disable, and remove system accounts in accordance with policy, procedures, prerequisites, and criteria.」即 must 在本副本里并非只落在补 ODP 值与联邦符合这两处：§2.2 之内已印出两句，第 3 章的讨论段也用它写系统能力（03.03.01 事件日志的讨论说，组织可能判定系统必须有记录每一次文件访问的能力，只因性能负担而在特定情形下才启用），Authority 段另用 shall。这些是通读所得的观察，不是穷举清单。可以确说的是：要求本体按 a/b/c 分项写成祈使句，其强制力来自合同。 限度分四层。§2.2 说明每条要求所附讨论的地位：「The discussion section is informative, not normative.」其下一句紧接理由：「It is not intended to extend the scope of a requirement or influence the solutions that organizations may use to satisfy a requirement.」§1.1 排除一类主体：「The requirements do not apply to nonfederal organizations that are collecting or maintaining information on behalf of a federal agency or using or operating a system on behalf of an agency.」§3 承认部分系统套不全：「Some systems, including specialized systems (e.g., industrial/process control systems, medical devices, computer numerical control machines), may have limitations on the application of certain security requirements.」Authority 段划出国家安全系统的条件适用：「such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems.」附录 E 又限定这份副本本身：「The current release of this publication does not include any errata updates.」四层各不同：讨论段不产生义务，代管信息的组织另按 FISMA 处理，专用系统以系统安全计划记持久例外，国家安全系统须明示批准。 门面板块按本份文本连读为「NIST Special Publication 800 NIST SP 800-171r3」（此处的编号重复是抽取所致），标题行「Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations」，作者行「Ron Ross Victoria Pillitteri」，部门行「Computer Security Division Information Technology Laboratory」，页眉行给出日期「NIST SP 800-171r3 May 2024」；免费获取行是「This publication is available free of charge from:」，其后是 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-171r3。出版史块给出评审与取代关系：「Approved by the NIST Editorial Review Board on 2024-04-23 Supersedes NIST Special Publication 800-171r2 (February 2020; Includes updates as of 01-28-2021)」，引用行给出两位作者与年份：「Ross R, Pillitteri V (2024) Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations.(National Institute of Standards and Technology, Gaithersburg, MD), NIST Special Publication (SP) NIST SP 800-171r3.」致谢页点名技术编辑与制作人员「Jim Foti, Jeff Brewer, Eduardo Takamura, Isabel Van Wyk, Cristina Ritfeld, Derek Sappington, and Carolyn Schmidt」，并另谢 Kelley Dempsey 的早期 CUI overlay 研究。附录 E 列出与上一版的差异首句：「This publication incorporates the following changes from the original edition (February 2020; updated January 28, 2021):」其条目之一为「Eliminated the distinction between basic and derived security requirements」。 - Wikipedia search entry for 保护非联邦系统中的受控非密信息（SP 800-171 Rev.3）. - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\]
