items.title: SHA-3 派生函数（SP 800-185）
items.text: 标准 ：SHA-3 派生函数：cSHAKE、KMAC、TupleHash 与 ParallelHash（SP 800-185）（SHA-3 Derived Functions: cSHAKE, KMAC, TupleHash and ParallelHash (SP 800-185)）。摘要首句给出文件性质与对象：「This Recommendation specifies four types of SHA-3-derived functions: cSHAKE, KMAC, TupleHash, and ParallelHash, each defined for a 128- and 256-bit security strength.」随后逐个自述：「cSHAKE is a customizable variant of the SHAKE function, as defined in Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 202.」、「KMAC (for KECCAK Message Authentication Code) is a variable-length message authentication code algorithm based on KECCAK; it can also be used as a pseudorandom function.」、「TupleHash is a variable-length hash function designed to hash tuples of input strings without trivial collisions.」与「ParallelHash is a variable-length hash function that can hash very long messages in parallel.」它规定的是四个函数族及其 128/256 两档强度，全部派生自 FIPS 202。摘要的口径止于此：它给出四个函数族、两档强度与每个族的自述，不给出任何协议里应取的值，也不定义 KECCAK 或 SHAKE 本身——FIPS 202 是它的上游，本文件只在派生函数这一层作规定。 §1 交代缺口在域分离：「Domain separation ensures that different named functions (such as SHA3-512 and SHAKE128) will be unrelated.」再把定制化的作用讲清：「Customization is analogous to strong typing in a programming language; such customization makes it extremely unlikely that computing one function with two different customization strings will yield the same answer.」其余三族要补的是基本函数没有的能力：「It then defines three additional SHA-3-derived functions, in Secs.4 through 6, that provide new functionality not directly available from the more basic functions.」风险因此被写成同一件事的两面：没有域分离，不同用途的输出可能彼此相关；有了 N 与 S，两次计算可被当作互不相干的函数。 分工写在编号章节：函数名不归用户，§3.4 说 N「This is intended for use by NIST in defining SHA-3-derived functions, and should only be set to values defined by NIST」，并直接约束用户：「Users of cSHAKE should not make up their own names--that kind of customization is the purpose of the customization string S, to be discussed in Sec.3.5.」§3.5 把选择权交给调用方：「The cSHAKE function also includes an input string (S) to allow users to customize their use of the function.」四族一律提供 128 与 256 两档：「cSHAKE, KMAC, TupleHash, and ParallelHash are all defined for two claimed security strengths: 128 bits and 256 bits.」两处的层级都是建议级：N 只应取 NIST 定义的值（原文 should only be set），名称也不建议由用户自创（原文 should not make up their own names）；S 由调用方选取，§3.5 只给出示例并允许实现限制其长度，本文件不为任何用途指定定制串。 限度有四处。一是参数无下限：「The customization string may be of any length less than 22040; however, implementations may restrict the length of S that they will accept.」（留存文本把 2 的 2040 次方抽成了 22040：同文件 right_encode 的有效性条件也印成同样丢掉上标的 0 x < 22040，可见上标在提取时丢失；此处照抄抽取件原样并如此说明）取值仍由协议或应用自己决定，本文件不指定用途。二是越界的代价：「Nonstandard values of N could cause interoperability problems with future NIST-defined functions.」三是 cSHAKE 自身的性质缺口：「Note that cSHAKE does not share this property.」「For q1< q2, cSHAKE(X, q1, N, S) is a prefix of cSHAKE(X, q2, N, S).」即短输出只是长输出的前缀，不像另外三族那样换长度即换函数。四是实现边界：「An implementation of cSHAKE may reasonably support only input strings and output lengths that are whole bytes; if so, a fractional-byte input string or a request for an output length that is not a multiple of 8 would result in an error.」另外，「Appendix B--Hashing into a Range (Informative)」标题自标为非规范性附录。 扉页首行为「NIST Special Publication 800-185」，作者与部门两行连读为「John Kelsey Shu-jen Chang Ray Perlner Computer Security Division Information Technology Laboratory」，DOI 行是「This publication is available free of charge from:」，DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-185。Authority 段的引用行给出日期与页数：「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-185, 32 pages (December 2016)」，同段限定适用面：「such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems」。关键词行整行列出：「authentication; cryptography; cSHAKE; customizable SHAKE function; hash function; information security; integrity; KECCAK; KMAC; message authentication code; parallel hashing; ParallelHash; PRF; pseudorandom function; SHA-3; SHAKE; tuple hashing; TupleHash.」。致谢页点名 KECCAK 团队的评审者：「The authors thank the KECCAK team members: Guido Bertoni, Joan Daemen」，另有一句「The authors also thank their colleagues for reviewing drafts of this document and contributing to its development.」以上各条合起来是这份文件的门板事实：出版物编号、三位作者与所在部门、免费获取的 DOI 行、带页数的正式引用行，以及致谢点名的外部评审者；文本未声明取代任何早期版本。 - Wikipedia search entry for SHA-3 派生函数：cSHAKE、KMAC、TupleHash 与 ParallelHash（SP 800-185）. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=SHA-3%20%E6%B4%BE%E7%94%9F%E5%87%BD%E6%95%B0%EF%BC%9AcSHAKE%E3%80%81KMAC%E3%80%81TupleHash%20%E4%B8%8E%20ParallelHash%EF%BC%88SP%20800-185%EF%BC%89 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] SHA-3 派生函数：cSHAKE、KMAC、TupleHash 与 ParallelHash（SP 800-185）的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 平台固件韧性指南（SP 800-193）
items.text: 标准 ：平台固件韧性指南（SP 800-193）（Platform Firmware Resiliency Guidelines (SP 800-193)）。摘要自述对象与性质：「This document provides technical guidelines and recommendations supporting resiliency of platform firmware and data against potentially destructive attacks.」并定义平台：「The platform is a collection of fundamental hardware and firmware components needed to boot and operate a system.」三原则在摘要中一句写尽：「The technical guidelines in this document promote resiliency in the platform by describing security mechanisms for protecting the platform against unauthorized changes, detecting unauthorized changes that occur, and recovering from attacks rapidly and securely.」执行摘要同句复述：「These guidelines are based on the following three principles:」并列出「Protection: Mechanisms for ensuring that Platform Firmware code and critical data remain in a state of integrity and are protected from corruption」。产出因此是机制层面的指南而非算法规范：它把韧性拆成保护、检测与恢复三件事，逐项给出可实施的准则，对象是平台内的固件与其配置数据，而不是某一台机器的启动固件。 风险写在摘要：「A successful attack on platform firmware could render a system inoperable, perhaps permanently, or requiring reprogramming by the original manufacturer, resulting in significant disruptions to users.」执行摘要说明为何难修：「Much of this firmware is highly privileged in the system architectures, and because this firmware is necessary for the system to operate, repairing this firmware can be challenging.」要补的缺口是既有指南只覆盖一类固件：「Earlier NIST publications have addressed the threat of attacks on one particular type of platform firmware: boot firmware, commonly known as the Basic Input/Output System (BIOS).」紧接着补上范围：「However, the platform consists of many other devices with firmware and configuration data.」四段合起来给出缺口的形状：损失未必是数据泄露，而是可用性被长期摧毁，修复又依赖原厂手段；此前的指南只覆盖一类固件，其余带固件与配置数据的器件未被同等对待。 该条目用于应用安全工程中的对象定位与步骤复述；引用时先确认输入、参数与版本，再判断结论是否仍适用。 它是指南而非强制。Authority 段自陈不改变既有权威：「Nor should these guidelines be interpreted as altering or superseding the existing authorities of the Secretary of Commerce, Director of the OMB, or any other federal official.」并写明联邦体系外的用法：「This publication may be used by nongovernmental organizations on a voluntary basis and is not subject to copyright in the United States.」§1.3 收窄威胁面：「The goal of this document is to provide principles and guidelines that can support platform resiliency primarily against remote attacks.」§1.4 记下一部分只是背景材料：「Section 2 provides informative material describing platform components and architectures.」Audience 段限定读者门槛：「The technical guidelines assume readers have expertise in the platform architectures and are targeted primarily at developers and engineers responsible for implementing firmware-level security technologies in systems and devices.」几处限制叠在一起：指南本身不新增强制力，威胁面以远程攻击为主，第 2 章自陈只是背景材料，且文本假定读者已具备平台架构方面的专业知识。 扉页首行是「NIST Special Publication 800-193」，作者与部门所在行连读为「Andrew Regenscheid Computer Security Division Information Technology Laboratory」，免费获取行写「This publication is available free of charge from:」，DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-193。Authority 段的引用行给出日期与页数：「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-193, 45 pages (May 2018)」，即 2018 年 5 月版；本文件未在门面板块声明取代任何出版物。致谢页把作者与评审者写在一起：「The author, Andrew Regenscheid of the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), wishes to thank his colleagues who reviewed drafts of this document and contributed to its technical content.」并列出业界与政府专家：「These experts included Chirag Schroff from Cisco; Mukund Khatri from Dell;」。 - Wikipedia search entry for 平台固件韧性指南（SP 800-193）. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%E5%9B%BA%E4%BB%B6%E9%9F%A7%E6%80%A7%E6%8C%87%E5%8D%97%EF%BC%88SP%20800-193%EF%BC%89 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 平台固件韧性指南（SP 800-193）的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 零信任架构（SP 800-207）
items.text: 标准 ：零信任架构（SP 800-207）（Zero Trust Architecture (SP 800-207)）。摘要第一句给术语定位：「Zero trust (ZT) is the term for an evolving set of cybersecurity paradigms that move defenses from static, network-based perimeters to focus on users, assets, and resources.」第二句给出架构一词：「A zero trust architecture (ZTA) uses zero trust principles to plan industrial and enterprise infrastructure and workflows.」核心假设紧随其后：「Zero trust assumes there is no implicit trust granted to assets or user accounts based solely on their physical or network location (i.e., local area networks versus the internet) or based on asset ownership (enterprise or personally owned).」§1 再补一句定义：「A zero trust architecture (ZTA) is an enterprise cybersecurity architecture that is based on zero trust principles and designed to prevent data breaches and limit internal lateral movement.」两句定义各管一层：前者把焦点从网络边界移到用户、资产与资源，后者把 ZTA 定位成企业网络安全架构并给出目的；授予信任的条件由摘要第三句限定，位置与归属都不再是理由。 动机是企业网络趋势使边界失效：「Zero trust is a response to enterprise network trends that include remote users, bring your own device (BYOD), and cloud-based assets that are not located within an enterpriseowned network boundary.」§1 说明边界为何不够：「Perimeter-based network security has also been shown to be insufficient since once attackers breach the perimeter, further lateral movement is unhindered.」并把对手假设写实：「Zero trust security models assume that an attacker is present in the environment and that an enterprise-owned environment is no different--or no more trustworthy--than any nonenterprise-owned environment.」§2 给出焦点转移：「Zero trust focuses on protecting resources (assets, services, workflows, network accounts, etc.), not network segments, as the network location is no longer seen as the prime component to the security posture of the resource.」四段串成一个论证：边界先失去意义，因为资产已不都在企业网络之内；边界失效的代价是横向移动不受阻；于是模型假定对手已在环境里，防护须围绕资源逐次判定，而非围绕网段。 文件先给出七条基本原则（措辞是设计准则的陈述句，不是命令式的义务条款）：「A zero trust architecture is designed and deployed with adherence to the following zero trust basic tenets:」第一条即「All data sources and computing services are considered resources.」§2 又给出一条总体要求：「Overall, enterprises need to develop and maintain dynamic risk-based policies for resource access and set up a system to ensure that these policies are enforced correctly and consistently for individual resource access requests.」并建议不要以登录推断后续请求可信（原文是 should not，不是禁止）：「This means that an enterprise should not rely on implied trustworthiness wherein if the subject has met a base authentication level (e.g., logging into an asset), all subsequent resource requests are assumed to be equally valid.」§3 把职责落到若干逻辑组件（原文自陈组件众多）：策略引擎「This component is responsible for the ultimate decision to grant access to a resource for a given subject.」与执行点「This system is responsible for enabling, monitoring, and eventually terminating connections between a subject and an enterprise resource.」同时声明这是模型：「Note that this is an ideal model showing logical components and their interactions.」 文件自陈给出的是模型与考虑，不是产品或方案。摘要写：「This document contains an abstract definition of zero trust architecture (ZTA) and gives general deployment models and use cases where zero trust could improve an enterprise's overall information technology security posture.」Audience 段补：「It is not intended to be a single deployment plan for ZTA as an enterprise will have unique business use cases and data assets that require safeguards.」§1 同样强调原则性质：「ZT is not a single architecture but a set of guiding principles for workflow, system design and operations」，并说明迁移是过程：「Transitioning to ZTA is a journey concerning how an organization evaluates risk in its mission and cannot simply be accomplished with a wholesale replacement of technology.」§5 直说风险不被消除：「No enterprise can eliminate cybersecurity risk.」并列出架构自身的新风险：「Any enterprise administrator with configuration access to the PE's rules may be able to perform unapproved changes or make mistakes that can disrupt enterprise operations.」三处自陈叠加：文件给的是定义与模型，不给部署计划，也不宣称消除风险，它甚至把决策组件自身列为攻击面。 扉页首行为「NIST Special Publication 800-207」，作者与部门行连读为「Scott Rose Oliver Borchert Advanced Network Technologies Division Information Technology Laboratory」，其后另列两位作者的机构：「Stu Mitchell Stu2Labs」与「Sean Connelly Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Security Agency」，DOI 行是「This publication is available free of charge from:」，DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-207。Authority 段引用行给出日期与页数：「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-207, 59 pages (August 2020)」。关键词行是「architecture; cybersecurity; enterprise; network security; zero trust.」署名页（本文拼作 Acknowledgments）交代出处：「This document is the product of a collaboration between multiple federal agencies and is overseen by the Federal CIO Council.」并点名参与者：「These include Greg Holden, project manager of the Federal CIO Council ZTA project」。以上合起来是这份文件的门板事实：编号与标题、四位作者及其机构、八月出版的日期与页数、免费获取的 DOI 行，以及联邦机构协作的署名说明。 - Wikipedia search entry for 零信任架构（SP 800-207）. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E9%9B%B6%E4%BF%A1%E4%BB%BB%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84%EF%BC%88SP%20800-207%EF%BC%89 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 零信任架构（SP 800-207）的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 状态散列基签名方案（SP 800-208）
items.text: 标准 ：状态散列基签名方案（Stateful Hash-based Signature Schemes）。摘要首句给出规定对象：「This recommendation specifies two algorithms that can be used to generate a digital signature」，随即点名四套方案：「the Leighton-Micali Signature (LMS) system and the eXtended Merkle Signature Scheme (XMSS), along with their multi-tree variants, the Hierarchical Signature System (HSS) and multi-tree XMSS (XMSSMT).」扉页标题行为「Recommendation for Stateful Hash-Based Signature Schemes」：两式都靠维护签名状态成立，而非无状态签名。摘要把两套基本式与它们的多树形式写在同一句里，题线中的 stateful 因此不是修饰：只有签名方知道下一个可用一次性密钥的编号，方案才谈得上安全。 风险写在 §1.2：私钥是一大堆一次性密钥，「The signer needs to ensure that no individual OTS key is ever used to sign more than one message.」一旦同一把签了两条消息，「then it would become computationally feasible for that attacker to forge signatures on arbitrary messages」。§1 交出取舍理由：「The security of the stateful HBS schemes in this publication depends only on the security of the underlying hash functions」，并补一句「it is believed that the security of hash functions will not be broken by the development of large-scale quantum computers」。§1.1 则承认代价：「Stateful HBS schemes are not suitable for general use because they require careful state management that is often difficult to assure」。三段连读给出取舍：安全性只落在散列函数的原像与第二原像难解上，代价是签名方必须守住状态；§1.1 那句不适用于一般用途，正是这一代价的直接表述。 措辞层级由前言说明界定，其中「indicate requirements to be followed strictly in order to conform to the publication and from which no deviation is permitted.」§4 的要求落在生成密钥对的一方：「each LM-OTS key in the system shall use the same parameter set, and the hash function used for the LMS system shall be the same as the hash function used in the LM-OTS keys.」以及「When generating LMS or HSS key pairs using SHA-256, the LMS and LM-OTS parameter sets shall be selected from the following two tables」。§3.1 关于 Winternitz 参数 x（秘密种子的位数）的一句只到建议级：「The size of x should generally correspond to the targeted security strength of the scheme.」。层级因此可分：参数表的选取属 shall 级，把 x 的位数配到目标强度只到 should 级；前言的措辞约定把前者定为不可偏离，后者列为首选而非强制。 它不取代现行数字签名标准：§1 自陈位置——「This publication supplements FIPS 186 [4] by specifying two additional digital signature schemes」。它也不是等待中的后量子签名标准：§1.1 写「NIST is in the process of developing standards for post-quantum secure digital signature schemes」，真正的替代件当时仍在制定。适用范围另有两处：§1 只批准子集——「This publication approves the use of some but not all of the parameter sets defined in [1] and [2] and also defines some new parameter sets.」并要求「This recommendation requires that key and signature generation be performed in hardware cryptographic modules that do not allow secret keying material to be exported, even in encrypted form.」 扉页首行为「NIST Special Publication 800-208」，作者行含「David A.Cooper Daniel C.Apon Quynh H.Dang」与「Morris J.Dworkin Carl A.Miller」；日期行为 2020 年 10 月，引用行「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-208, 59 pages (October 2020) CODEN: NSPUE2」，免费获取行后接 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-208。关键词行给出主题范围：「cryptography; digital signatures; hash-based signatures; public-key cryptography.」留存副本未设致谢页，亦未声明被后续修订取代。这些是文件自己的门面板信息：编号、标题行、六位作者、页数、出版月与 DOI；本份文本无致谢页，也未声明被后续版本取代，版次事实止于 2020 年 10 月这一版。 - Wikipedia search entry for 状态散列基签名方案. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81%E6%95%A3%E5%88%97%E5%9F%BA%E7%AD%BE%E5%90%8D%E6%96%B9%E6%A1%88 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 状态散列基签名方案的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 安全软件开发框架 1.1 版（SP 800-218）
items.text: 标准 ：安全软件开发框架（SP 800-218）（Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1 Recommendations for Mitigating the Risk of Software Vulnerabilities）。摘要先点名对象：「This document recommends the Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)」，随即给出其构成：「a core set of high-level secure software development practices that can be integrated into each SDLC implementation」。扉页标题行为「Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1」与「Recommendations for Mitigating the Risk of Software Vulnerabilities」；§2 说明它是既有实践的汇编与分组：「The practices are organized into four groups」。三段合起来说明性质：它是可并入任一生命周期的高层实践集，本身不引入新实践与新术语，四组结构是它的主要产出。 缺口写在摘要首句：「Few software development life cycle (SDLC) models explicitly address software security in detail, so secure software development practices usually need to be added to each SDLC model to ensure that the software being developed is well-secured.」§1 同一判断落到做法：「secure software development practices should be integrated throughout it for three reasons: to reduce the number of vulnerabilities in released software」。摘要还给出受让方一侧的理由：「Because the framework provides a common vocabulary for secure software development, software acquirers can also use it to foster communications with suppliers in acquisition processes and other management activities.」引文把问题分置两端：生产端的缺口是安全实践未写进模型，采购端的缺口是双方缺少共同词汇，框架同时对着这两处。 全文义务层级为 should，主语是组织。执行摘要给出总要求：「Organizations should integrate the SSDF throughout their existing software development practices, express their secure software development requirements to third-party suppliers using SSDF conventions, and acquire software that meets the practices described in the SSDF.」§2 的四组定义逐组以组织为主语，其中「2.Protect the Software (PS): Organizations should protect all components of their software from tampering and unauthorized access.」§1 另把云场景的分配义务落到租户：「The tenant organization should establish an agreement with the providers that specifies which party is responsible for each practice and task and how each provider will attest to their conformance with the agreement.」三句的主语都是组织或租户，层级全是 should：框架给的是建议而非强制条款，责任分配则要求写进协议，指明由谁执行各实践以及谁来证明。 §1 自陈两处不做。一是不给实现办法：「This document identifies secure software development practices but does not prescribe how to implement them.」二是不造新词与新实践：「This document does not introduce new practices or define new terminology.」同一节又限制使用方式：「The intention of the SSDF is not to create a checklist to follow, but to provide a basis for planning and implementing a risk-based approach to adopting secure software development practices.」与既有框架的关系也有限：脚注说明「the SSDF practices do not map to them」，即可支持网络安全框架但不与之映射。 扉页首行「NIST Special Publication 800-218」，作者三位为 Souppaya、Scarfone 与 Dodson，其中第三位的身份注记为「Former NIST employee; all work for this publication was done while at NIST.」；日期行 2022 年 2 月，引用行「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-218, 36 pages (February 2022) CODEN: NSPUE2」，免费获取行后接 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-218。对象由受众一节界定：「There are two primary audiences for this document.The first is software producers」。致谢页列出协助者：「The authors thank all of their NIST colleagues for their support throughout the SSDF update」。文末读者说明一节交代它的时效：「The publication will be updated periodically to reflect your inputs and feedback.」 - Wikipedia search entry for 安全软件开发框架（SP 800-218）. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E8%BD%AF%E4%BB%B6%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E6%A1%86%E6%9E%B6%EF%BC%88SP%20800-218%EF%BC%89 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 安全软件开发框架（SP 800-218）的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 分组密码工作模式建议
items.text: 标准 ：分组密码工作模式建议（Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation）。SP 800-38A 的摘要列出五种保密模式：「This recommendation defines five confidentiality modes of operation for use with an underlying symmetric key block cipher algorithm: Electronic Codebook (ECB), Cipher Block Chaining (CBC), Cipher Feedback (CFB), Output Feedback (OFB), and Counter (CTR).」——它不定义新算法，只规定算法的使用方式。 目的句只有一句：§1「This publication provides recommendations regarding modes of operation to be used with symmetric key block cipher algorithms.」摘要则说明它给出的五档模式能做什么——「The five modes--the Electronic Codebook (ECB), Cipher Block Chaining (CBC), Cipher Feedback (CFB), Output Feedback (OFB), and Counter (CTR) modes--can provide data confidentiality.」需要多档模式的理由不在本文里另加铺陈，本文件只做这一件事。 使用面是联邦密码模块的验证依据：§2（Authority）里的符合性测试段落写明「Conformance testing for implementations of the modes of operation that are specified in this recommendation will be conducted within the framework of the Cryptographic Module Validation Program (CMVP), a joint effort of the NIST and the Communications Security Establishment of the Government of Canada.」——即选定模式后按本建议校验实现。 限度一是范围：摘要把可提供的服务限定在 confidentiality 一项，本文件不涉及认证加密模式，也不在此列出后续模式文件。限度二是权威：§2 明确「Nor should this recommendation be interpreted as altering or superseding the existing authorities of the Secretary of Commerce, the Director of the Office of Management and Budget, or any other Federal official.」它不改变既有强制力，也不覆盖国家安全系统。 版本与前置关系：官方引用行为「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-38A 2001 ED, 66 pages (December 2001)」；§2 记下此前已有两份标准管过模式——「FIPS Pub.81 [4] specifies the ECB, CBC, CFB, and OFB modes of the Data Encryption Standard (DES).」以及 FIPS 46-3 对 TDEA 七档模式的规定。本文件并未宣称取代 FIPS 81，它把自己放进既有权威之下。 技术参数与复算边界 该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：分组密码工作模式建议的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 分组密码工作模式建议 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 items.title: CMAC 认证模式
items.text: 标准 ：CMAC 认证模式（The CMAC Mode for Authentication）。摘要首句给出对象：「This Recommendation specifies a message authentication code (MAC) algorithm based on a symmetric key block cipher.」次句给出用途与产出：「This block cipher-based MAC algorithm, called CMAC, may be used to provide assurance of the authenticity and, hence, the integrity of binary data.」§1 把它安放在系列文件之中：「This publication is the second Part in a series of Recommendations regarding modes of operation of symmetric key block ciphers.」关键词行同样只列认证一面：「KEY WORDS: authentication; block cipher; cryptography; information security; integrity; message authentication code; mode of operation.」本文件规定 MAC 的生成与验证，不规定加密，也不规定密钥如何建立。 缺口是既有构造不可用：§3 写「The basic Cipher Block Chaining MAC algorithm (CBC-MAC) has security deficiencies [9].」并交代替代来源：「The core of the CMAC algorithm is a variation of CBC-MAC that Black and Rogaway proposed and analyzed under the name XCBC in Ref.[2] and submitted to NIST in Ref.[1].」改进链随后两句：「Iwata and Kurosawa proposed an improvement of XCBC and named the resulting algorithm One-Key CBC-MAC (OMAC) in Ref.[6] and in Ref.[5], their initial submission to NIST」与收束的「The OMAC1 variation efficiently reduces the key size of XCBC.CMAC is equivalent to OMAC1.」适用场景另有一句：「CMAC may be appropriate for information systems in which an approved block cipher is more readily available than an approved hash function.」即本文件的理由是补上分组密码侧的认证构造，而不是再造一种散列基 MAC。 义务写在编号章节，措辞分三级。§5.2 的两条 shall 限定底层密码与密钥：「The underlying block cipher shall be approved, and the key shall be generated uniformly at random, or close to uniformly at random, i.e., so that each possible key is (nearly) equally likely to be generated.」与「The key shall be secret and shall be used exclusively for the CMAC mode of the chosen block cipher.」密钥建立只到建议级：「To fulfill the requirements on the key, the key should be established among the parties to the information within an approved key management structure」。碰撞风险归运行系统：「For any system in which CMAC is implemented, the risk that an attacker can detect and exploit a collision shall be limited to a level that is appropriate to the value of the data.」三级措辞因此可分：算法与密钥是硬要求，密钥建立只是建议，把碰撞概率压到与数据价值相称的水准则落在部署一方的工程判断。 四处限度各自不同层。§2 划出适用边界：「such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems.」§5.2 把密钥工作交出去：「the details of the establishment and management of keys are outside the scope of this Recommendation.」附录 A.1 承认认证保证有上限：「however, this assurance, as for any MAC algorithm, is not absolute.」并把短标签的条件写明：「A value of Tlen that is less than 64 shall only be used in conjunction with a careful analysis of the risks of accepting an inauthentic message as authentic.」附录 C 更直接说明本算法不管重放：「In some protocols an attacker may even be able to present to a verifier a message-MAC pair that the verifier itself generated earlier in the protocol.」即认证有效不等于来源方就是出示者，防重放须由协议另加序号、时间戳或 nonce。 这份文本顶部就是 NIST 的归档横幅：「The attached publication has been archived (withdrawn), and is provided solely for historical purposes.」横幅记下取代关系「The attached publication has been superseded by the following publication(s)」，其后继条目仍是 800-38B 与同一分册标题，作者与日期两行连读为「M.Dworkin Publication Date(s): October 6, 2016」；更新说明为「SP 800-38B is updated by the October 6, 2016 release of 800-38B, which includes editorial changes (as of October 6, 2016).」本体扉页连读为「NIST Special Publication 800-38B Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation: The CMAC Mode for Authentication Morris Dworkin」，日期行是 May 2005，引用行为「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-38B, 23 pages (May 2005) CODEN: NSPUE2」。本份正文不含免费获取的 DOI 行，横幅给出的标识符为 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-38B。 - Wikipedia search entry for CMAC 认证模式. 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] CMAC 认证模式的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S items.title: CCM 认证与保密模式
items.text: 标准 ：CCM 认证与保密模式（The CCM Mode for Authentication and Confidentiality）。摘要第一句是模式定义：「This Recommendation defines a mode of operation, called CCM, for a symmetric key block cipher algorithm.」第二句写明组合方式：「CCM may be used to provide assurance of the confidentiality and the authenticity of computer data by combining the techniques of the Counter (CTR) mode and the Cipher Block Chaining-Message Authentication Code (CBC-MAC) algorithm.」关键词行把两面并列出来：「KEY WORDS: authenticated encryption; authentication; block cipher; confidentiality; cryptography; encryption; information security; message authentication code; mode of operation.」§1 交代其在系列中的位置：「This publication is the third Part in a series of Recommendations regarding modes of operation of symmetric key block cipher algorithms.」即本文件不提出新算法，只把两种既有原语装进同一套过程，认证与保密两面并列出现；密钥从哪里来、协议怎样取值都不在其规定之内。 要解决的是一次处理同时给出机密与认证：§3 写「CCM consists of two related processes: generation-encryption and decryption-verification, which combine two cryptographic primitives: counter mode encryption and cipher block chainingbased authentication.」并限定所用原语：「Only the forward cipher function of the block cipher algorithm is used within these primitives.」认证的相对优势另有一句：「A MAC provides stronger assurance of authenticity than a checksum or an error detecting code.」风险则落在密钥上：「The security properties of CCM depend, at a minimum, on the secrecy of the key.」四句合起来是本文件的立场：两个原语合用一把密钥，只要前向密码函数即可，代价是密钥保密成为最低前提。 §5.1 的要求多为 shall 级：「The underlying block cipher algorithm shall be approved, and a secret key for the block cipher algorithm shall be generated uniformly at random, or close to uniformly at random」与「The key shall be kept secret and shall only be used for the CCM mode.」同节还给出调用总量的硬顶：「The total number of invocations of the block cipher algorithm during the lifetime of the key shall be limited to 261.」（此处的 261 是 2 的 61 次方在抽取时丢了上标）§5.3 把 nonce 写成不得重复：「The nonce shall be non-repeating in the sense that any two distinct data pairs to be protected by CCM during the lifetime of the key shall be assigned distinct nonces.」并补一句：「The nonce is not required to be random.」几处措辞层级一致：算法须批准、密钥须保密且专用、调用次数封顶、nonce 须唯一而随机性不作要求；五条都落在实现与密钥的取值上，没有一条涉及原语自身的强度。 限度分层写明。适用面：§2「such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems.」使用形态：§3「CCM is not designed to support partial processing or stream processing.」底层密码：§3「thus, CCM cannot be used with the Triple Data Encryption Algorithm」。被组合的原语本身不获批准：§5.2「This Recommendation does not approve CBC-MAC as an authentication mode outside of the context of the CCM specification」。密钥工作另交他文：§5.1「Key establishment and key management are outside the scope of this Recommendation.」标签长度亦有条件：附录 B.2「a value of Tlen that is less than 64 shall not be used without a careful analysis of the risks of accepting inauthentic data as authentic.」六处限度分属不同层：适用面排除国家安全系统，使用形态要求整包数据到位，可选密码受分组长度约束，被借用的 CBC-MAC 本身不获批准，密钥工作另交他文，短标签须另做风险分析。 扉页连读为「NIST Special Publication 800-38C Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation: The CCM Mode for Authentication and Confidentiality Morris Dworkin」，分册标题用 Confidentiality 而非 Privacy；日期行写「May 2004 (errata update 07-20-2007; corrected value of parameter B on p.19)」，即 2004 年 5 月初版并于 2007 年 7 月 20 日并入勘误。引用行给出页数与日期：「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-38C 25 pages (May 2004) CODEN: NSPUE2」，本份文本无 DOI 行。附录 A 交代标准化前的出处：「With these functions, this specification of CCM is essentially equivalent to the specification of CCM in the draft amendment [4] to the IEEE Standard 802.11 for wireless local area networks [5].」题页、引用行与附录合起来给出这份副本的版次事实：分册号与标题、单一作者、初版月份、并入勘误的日期与页数，以及该模式在标准化之前的 WLAN 出处。 - Wikipedia search entry for CCM 认证与保密模式. items.title: GCM 与 GMAC 模式
items.text: 标准 ：GCM 与 GMAC 模式（Galois/Counter Mode and GMAC）。文件标题即定义：「NIST Special Publication 800-38D Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation: Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) and GMAC」，作者 Morris Dworkin，日期行「November 2007」。它把 GCM 与 GMAC 一并规范化：前者是加密+认证的模式，后者是只产出认证码的用法。 它解决的是 加密又要认证又要可验证 的合并需求：文件给出 GCM 与 GMAC 两种用法，并把唯一性要求单列一节——§8 名为「Uniqueness Requirement on IVs and Keys」。§2 只把符合性放在 CMVP 框架里，未提及其它验证计划。 使用面是作为经验证的分组密码模式来部署：§2 要求实现按 CMVP 路径验证，§8 给出的是可算的下界：「The probability that the authenticated encryption function ever will be invoked with the same IV and the same key on two (or more) distinct sets of input data shall be no greater than 2-32.」；被转发协议如何组织密钥与 IV，不在本文件之内。 限度一是那条 几乎完全失效 的警告，但它是有条件的：原文写「a breach of the requirement in Sec.8 for the uniqueness of the initialization strings may compromise the security assurance almost entirely」，并结论式建议「this mode of operation should not be deployed unless compliance with this uniqueness requirement is ensured」。限度二是文件其实两边都谈：8.1 节标题就是 Key Establishment，指向 TLS、IKE v1/v2 与 SSH 的密钥导出函数；8.2 节标题是 IV Constructions，给出确定式与基于随机数生成器两种构造。它没有做的是定义一个密钥协商协议、或规定某个具体协议如何取用初始向量——那部分机制留在本建议的范围之外。 时间线：标题块日期为 2007 年 11 月，作者 Morris Dworkin；参考文献列出 McGrew 与 Viega 的 INDOCRYPT ’04 论文（该条目已核对的编号 [7]）与 2005 年的 gcm-revised-spec 网页链接——设计公布与标准化之间存在数年间隔，本文件是后者。 技术参数与复算边界 该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：GCM 与 GMAC 模式的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 GCM 与 GMAC 模式 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。 复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。 参数与状态规模 公式 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\) 的输入、输出和单位必须逐项登记；复算顺序为：1. 读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数 2. 按标准表换算等效强度 3. 取最弱分量作为系统强度。 状态规模、密钥长度、分组长度和轮数决定复杂度；这些量不能从标题推断，必须以标准或实现文档为准。 - items.title: XTS-AES 存储保密模式
items.text: 标准 ：XTS 存储加密模式（The XTS-AES Mode for Confidentiality on Storage Devices）。摘要写明本文件的动作是引用批准：「This publication approves the XTS-AES mode of the AES algorithm by reference to IEEE Std 1619-2007, subject to one additional requirement, as an option for protecting the confidentiality of data on storage devices.」同一摘要立刻减一项服务：「The mode does not provide authentication of the data or its source.」§1 交代系列位置：「This publication is the fifth Part in a series of Recommendations regarding modes of operation of symmetric key block ciphers.」即本文件不重述算法步骤，规定对象是外部标准之上的一个附加要求与其适用性。 对象来自另一标准：§3 写「The Security in Storage Working Group (SISWG) of the P1619 Task Group of the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, Inc (IEEE) developed and specified XTS-AES in IEEE Std.1619-2007 [2].」本文件要补的是把该构造收进 NIST 的批准清单并限定场景：「The XTS-AES mode was designed for the cryptographic protection of data on storage devices that use of fixed length “data units,” as defined in Ref.[2].」设计来源则追溯到外部工作：「The XTS-AES mode is an instantiation of Rogaway’s XEX (XOR Encrypt XOR) tweakable block cipher」。即本文件自陈的立场是引用外部标准加以批准，并声明该模式面向存储而非通用加密。 唯一的附加要求写成 shall 级，落在实现方：§4「The length of the data unit for any instance of an implementation of XTS-AES shall not exceed 220 AES blocks.」（220 同样是丢了上标的 2 的 20 次方）同段立刻标明该限的来源与强制程度差别：「Note that Subclause 5.1 of Ref.[2] recommends this limit but does not require it.」符合性的定义是条件式的：「An implementation of the XTS-AES encryption mode may claim conformance with this Recommendation if every supported instance satisfies this length requirement for a data unit, in addition to all of the requirements in Clauses 1-6 of Ref.[2].」验证路径写在同节末段：「Conformance testing for implementations of XTS-AES is conducted within the framework of the Cryptographic Module Validation Program (CMVP), a joint effort of NIST and the Communications Security Establishment Canada.」四句合起来是本文件的实际分量：算法步骤留在外部标准，NIST 只补一条数据单元长度上限，符合性的申报系于该上限与外部标准条款 1 至 6 同时满足，验证再交给 CMVP 路径。 限度一是服务本身：§3「Authentication is not provided, because the P1619 Task Group designed XTS-AES to provide encryption without data expansion, so alternative cryptographic methods that incorporate an authentication tag are precluded.」限度二是场景：§3「The XTS-AES mode was not designed for other purposes, such as the encryption of data in transit.」限度三是物理位置由实现自定：§5「Subclause 5.1 of [2] indicates that an implementation of XTS-AES should include a mapping between the pairs of indices that define the blocks (and possibly a single partial block) of a data unit and their physical location in the storage device, but that the mapping itself is outside the scope of the standard.」适用性上，§2 的措辞带条件：「but such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems.」四条合起来是：无认证、不用于传输、块的物理次序与位置交由实现与外部标准，国家安全系统的适用另需明示批准。 页眉首行给出编号与日期「NIST Special Publication 800-38E January, 2010」，扉页日期行为 January 2010，作者栏 Morris Dworkin；引用行是「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-38E, 9 pages (January 2010) CODEN: NSPUE2」，本份文本无 DOI 行。致谢页点名外部工作组与评审同事：「The author wishes to thank Matt Ball, the Chair of the Security in Storage Working Group of the IEEE P1619 Task Group, as well as the author’s colleagues who reviewed drafts of this publication and contributed to its development, especially Elaine Barker, Lily Chen, John Kelsey, Tim Polk, Bill Burr, and Sharon Keller.」附录 A 的书目给出被引用的标准及其日期：「IEEE Std 1619-2007, The XTS-AES Tweakable Block Cipher, Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, Inc., Apr.18, 2008.」即 2007 年编号的标准在 2008 年 4 月发布，本文件于 2010 年 1 月据其批准。 - Wikipedia search entry for XTS 存储加密模式. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=XTS%20%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E5%8A%A0%E5%AF%86%E6%A8%A1%E5%BC%8F - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] XTS items.title: 密钥包装方法
items.text: 标准 ：密钥包装方法（Methods for Key Wrapping）。摘要第一句给出主题与两面服务：「This publication describes cryptographic methods that are approved for “key wrapping,” i.e., the protection of the confidentiality and integrity of cryptographic keys.」第二句列出新增的模式：「this publication specifies two new, deterministic authenticated-encryption modes of operation of the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm: the AES Key Wrap (KW) mode and the AES Key Wrap With Padding (KWP) mode.」第三句为遗留用途保留一项：「An analogous mode with the Triple Data Encryption Algorithm (TDEA) as the underlying block cipher, called TKW, is also specified, to support legacy applications.」§1 把目的压缩为一句：「The purpose of this part is to provide approved methods for key wrapping, i.e., the protection of cryptographic keys.」三个名字就是本文件的产出：两支 AES 模式与一支 TDEA 变体，被保护对象写作密钥本身；这些密钥如何生成并不在文件之内。 §3.1 先给设计目标：「KW, KWP, and TKW were designed to protect the confidentiality and the authenticity/integrity of cryptographic keys.」再给出理由本身：「Each provides an option for protecting keys in a manner that is distinct from the methods that protect general data.」与「Segregating keys from general data can provide an extra layer of protection.」但同一节立刻取消必要性：「there is no requirement to protect cryptographic keys with a distinct cryptographic method.」鲁棒性的代价也写在这里：「each bit of output can be expected to depend in a nontrivial fashion on each bit of input」，其下一句指出这是以吞吐率为代价换得。故本文件补足的是可分离保护密钥的批准方法，不是把密钥保护变成单独方法的义务。 §5.1 把底层密码与密钥写成 shall：「For KW and KWP, the underlying block cipher shall be approved, and the block size shall be 128 bits.」与「The KEK shall be secret, i.e., disclosed only to parties that are authorized to know the protected information.」§5.3.1 给出长度上限：「the plaintext for KW-AE shall be limited to fewer than 254 semiblocks」（此处 254 为 2 的 54 次方丢上标所得）。符合性按函数申报，共六项：§8「An implementation may claim conformance to one or more of the following six functions: KWAE, KW-AD, KWP-AE, KWP-AD, TKW-AE, and TKW-AD.」验证路径写在 §2：「Conformance testing for implementations of this Recommendation will be conducted within the framework of the Cryptographic Algorithm Validation Program (CAVP) and the Cryptographic Module Validation Program (CMVP).」同节把措辞层级钉死：「The requirements of this Recommendation are indicated by the word “shall.”」五句的层级因此一致：算法须批准且分组长度为 128 比特，KEK 须保密，明文长度封顶，符合性按六个函数分别申报，验证走 CAVP 与 CMVP 两条路径。 限度一是遗留算法的现在时态：§8「TKW-AE and TKW-AD are approved to support legacy systems but should not be used for new applications.」同段还排除内部构件单独使用：「The associated wrapping and unwrapping functions, W, W-1, TW, and TW-1, are not approved for use independently of these six functions.」限度二是密钥管理不在范围内：§5.1「The management of KEKs is outside the scope of this publication.」验证也有覆盖不到处：§2「Some of these requirements may be out-of-scope for CMVP or CAVP validation testing, and thus are the responsibility of entities using, implementing, installing, or configuring applications that incorporate this Recommendation.」限度三是确定性带来的信息泄露：附录 A.1「Each key-wrap algorithm in this Recommendation is deterministic: for a given designated cipher function and KEK, any invocation of the authenticated-encryption function on a given plaintext produces the same ciphertext.」其结论一句为「any pair of ciphertexts reveals whether the corresponding plaintexts are equal」。附录 A.5 另记外部分析的批评：「the authors emphasize the lack of a proof that the underlying structure of KW meets the goal of deterministic authenticated encryption」。 页眉首行为「NIST Special Publication 800-38F December 2012」，扉页日期同为 December 2012，作者 Morris Dworkin；引用行「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-38F, 30 pages (December 2012) CODEN: NSPUE2」，本份文本无 DOI 行，分册标题作 Methods for Key Wrapping。致谢页列出评审同事与早期草稿的参与者：「The author wishes to thank his colleagues who reviewed drafts of this publication and contributed to its development, especially Elaine Barker, Meltem Turan, Allen Roginsky, Lily Chen, Donghoon Chang, Sharon Keller, Tim Polk, John Kelsey, Ray Perlner, Tim Hall, and Souradyuti Paul.」以及「Heather Pearce worked extensively on early drafts of this publication.」§3.2 交代标准化前的四个时间点：「In 2001, NIST posted a document entitled “AES Key Wrap Specification”」、「In 2002, two industry groups published specifications of key-wrap algorithms」与「In 2009, a different padding scheme was specified in RFC 5649 [4], referencing elements of the specification in [11].」 - Wikipedia search entry for 密钥包装方法. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E5%AF%86%E9%92%A5%E5%8C%85%E8%A3%85%E6%96%B9%E6%B3%95 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 密钥包装方法的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 格式保留加密模式
items.text: 标准 ：NIST SP 800-38G 格式保留加密模式（NIST SP 800-38G Format-Preserving Encryption Modes）。摘要给出方法与定位：「This Recommendation specifies two methods, called FF1 and FF3, for format-preserving encryption.」并说明二者关系——「Both of these methods are modes of operation for an underlying, approved symmetric-key block cipher algorithm.」即密文保持明文格式（长度与字母表）。 动机写在 §2：格式保留加密面向的不是二进制数据，而是「designed for data that is not necessarily binary」，并且「FPE facilitates the targeting of encryption to sensitive information, as well as the retrofitting of encryption technology to legacy applications」——老系统的数据字段不便改长度或格式。关键词表只给检索入口：「Block cipher; confidentiality; encryption; FF1; FF3; format-preserving encryption」。 使用形态是在批准分组密码之上调用 FF1/FF3；一致性测试一节把它接入验证框架，文档要求底层算法为「an underlying, approved symmetric-key block cipher algorithm」，因此在实现里通常落到 AES。 限度一是构造前提：两个模式都是建立在分组密码之上的 Feistel 置换，作用在固定进制的数字串上，而非任意格式；「an underlying, approved symmetric-key block cipher algorithm」是必要条件。限度二是参数下限的两种语气：附录区分了硬性下限与推荐值——radix^minlen 至少 100 是为了排除一类通用 meet-in-the-middle 攻击，而「the value radix minlen should generally be at least one million」在原文里是 suggested rather than required。 版本与更新痕迹在标题页：日期行「March 2016」，引用行「Spec.Publ.800-38G, 28 pages (March 2016)」，页眉还留有「INCLUDES UPDATES AS OF 08-04-2016: PAGE I」，即 2016 年 8 月 4 日并入专利披露说明的版次。§2 交代历史一笔：第三模式 FF2（提交时名 VAES3）曾列入初稿，公开评审后被撤下。 技术参数与复算边界 该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：NIST SP 800-38G 格式保留加密模式的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 NIST SP 800-38G 格式保留加密模式 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。 复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。 - Wikipedia search entry for NIST SP 800-38G 格式保留加密模式. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=NIST%20SP%20800-38G%20%E6%A0%BC%E5%BC%8F%E4%BF%9D%E7%95%99%E5%8A%A0%E5%AF%86%E6%A8%A1%E5%BC%8F - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] NIST SP 800-38G 格式保留加密模式的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 评估信息与系统中的安全与隐私控制（SP 800-53A Rev.5）
items.text: 标准 ：评估信息与系统中的安全与隐私控制（SP 800-53A Rev.5）（Assessing Security and Privacy Controls in Information Systems and Organizations (SP 800-53A Rev.摘要首句给出方法与程序两样产出及其框架：「This publication provides a methodology and set of procedures for conducting assessments of security and privacy controls employed within systems and organizations within an effective risk management framework.」次句钉住对齐对象：「The assessment procedures, executed at various phases of the system development life cycle, are consistent with the security and privacy controls in NIST Special Publication 800-53, Revision 5.」第三句把程序定性为可裁剪的起点：「The procedures are customizable and can be easily tailored to provide organizations with the needed flexibility to conduct security and privacy control assessments that support organizational risk management processes and are aligned with the stated risk tolerance of the organization.」§1.1 把动作再压缩一次：「The purpose of this publication is to provide guidelines for building effective security and privacy assessment plans, as well as a comprehensive set of procedures for assessing the effectiveness of security and privacy controls employed in systems and organizations.」并指明所依据的控制目录：「The guidelines apply to the security and privacy controls defined in [SP 800-53] (as amended), Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations.」关键词行把产出物列全，含「Open Security Controls Assessment Language; OSCAL」——它因此给出评估的程序与格式，不给出控制本身。 第一章开篇给出因果位置：「Once employed within a system, security and privacy controls are assessed to determine their overall effectiveness (i.e., the extent to which the controls are implemented correctly, operating as intended, and producing the desired outcome with respect to meeting the security and privacy requirements for the system and the organization).」执行摘要先排除一种误用：「Security and privacy control assessments are not about checklists, simple pass/fail results, or generating paperwork to pass inspections or audits.」其下一句给出它真正承担的功能：「Rather, control assessments are the principal vehicle used to verify that selected security and privacy controls are implemented and meeting stated goals and objectives.」同一节说明设计目标在灵活与一致之间：「A major design objective for SP 800-53A is to provide an assessment framework and initial starting point for assessment procedures that are flexible enough to meet the needs of different organizations while providing consistency in conducting control assessments.」并在 RMF 中定位：「SP 800-53A addresses the Assess and Monitor steps of the RMF and provides guidance on the security and privacy control assessment processes.」§2.3 则给出证据单位：「An assurance case is a body of evidence organized into an argument demonstrating that some claim about a system holds (i.e., is assured).」要补的缺口因此是选择之后的证明环节：控制被选中不等于被正确实现并起作用。 程序与判定责任写在编号章节，主语是 assessors 与 organizations。印出的 2.4 节界定方法与对象（本份文本把它报在 §2.3 名下）：「Assessment methods define the nature of the assessor actions and include examine, interview, and test.」与「Assessment objects identify the specific items being assessed as part of a given control and include specifications, mechanisms, activities, and individuals.」力度选择归组织，同属印出的 2.4 而非 2.3：「The organization determines the assessment methods needed to provide the level of assurance required by the organization.」§1.1 把程序定性为起点而非清单：「The guidance in this publication has been developed with the intention of enabling organizations to tailor the basic assessment procedures provided.」并接一句「The assessment procedures are used as a starting point for and as input to the assessment plan.」§3.2.2 把选取动作落到评估者：「For each control in the security plan and privacy plan to be included in the assessment, assessors select the corresponding assessment procedure from Chapter 4.」同节说明覆盖范围：「SP 800-53A provides assessment procedures for each security and privacy control and control enhancement in [SP 800-53].」§3.2.3 给出裁剪层级：「Organizations have the flexibility to perform the tailoring process at the organization level for all systems or common controls, at the individual system level, or using a combination of organization-level and system-specific approaches.」该条目所引的这几节不见 shall，其措辞是现在时与 may 一类；本副本通篇只有一处 shall，即 Authority 段的条件句（broken 段所引），不能据此说全文件不用 shall。义务形式在引文范围内主要是职责归属：评估者选程序、组织定力度与频率。 限度有四处，各自不同层。§1.1 划适用面：「The security and privacy guidelines in this publication are applicable to federal systems other than those systems designated as national security systems, as defined in 44 U.S.C., Section 3542.」Authority 段的措辞是条件式的：「Such information security standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of the appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems.」§1.1 的脚注把更细的执行层交出去：「Such test scripts are at a lower level of detail than provided by the assessment procedures contained in this guidance and are, therefore, beyond the scope of this publication.」第四章目录前的 CAUTIONARY NOTE 排除清单化误读：「the potential assessment methods are not intended to be mandatory or exclusive.」并同样处理对象列表：「In addition, the set of potential assessment objects listed in the catalog are not intended to be mandatory but rather a set from which the necessary and sufficient set of objects for a given assessment can be selected to make the appropriate determinations.」本份留存文本另有一处限制属于抽取而非文件：自第四章过程目录起，该章的表与页脚把连字换成私人区码点，ti 作 U+E000、tt 作 U+E003，故词形印作 Organiza 接 U+E000 接 onal、informa 接 U+E000 接 on 一类（按此形态分别有 1215 与 2843 处），页脚里的下载行则印作 h 接 U+E003 接 ps；字面串 Organizaonal、informaon、hps 在副本中一处也没有，而完好的 https 另有 137 处。这些不可见码点使被损伤的词无法按字面引用，故该区的程序文本不作引用。 扉页三行按连排印为一个块「NIST Special Publication 800-53A Revision 5 Assessing Security and Privacy Controls in Information Systems and Organizations JOINT TASK FORCE」，署名不是个人而是跨部门工作组；日期由引用行给出页数与日期「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-53A, Rev.5, 733 pages (January 2022) CODEN: NSPUE2」，免费获取行是「This publication is available free of charge from:」，其后是 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-53Ar5。工作组身份由致谢页首句给出：「This publication was developed by the Joint Task Force Interagency Working Group.」该页另把前任贡献者按名册列出，并记本系列的起点：「The authors wanted to acknowledge the many individuals who contributed to previous versions of Special Publication 800-53A since its inception in 2005.」被点名的官员含国防部条目的「HON.John Sherman Chief Information Officer」等。版次事实来自前置的格式说明块：「The new format for assessment procedures introduced in Special Publication (SP) 800-53A Revision 4, is further improved in this revision (SP 800-53A Revision 5).」这份副本不含出版史块、取代声明或撤回横幅，第 800-53 号的编号一致性在同块中以注释交代。 - Wikipedia search entry for 评估信息与系统中的安全与隐私控制（SP 800-53A Rev.5）. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E8%AF%84%E4%BC%B0%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%E4%B8%8E%E7%B3%BB%E7%BB%9F%E4%B8%AD%E7%9A%84%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E4%B8%8E%E9%9A%90%E7%A7%81%E6%8E%A7%E5%88%B6%EF%BC%88SP%20800-53A%20Rev.5%EF%BC%89 items.title: 成对密钥协商方案
items.text: 标准 ：成对密钥协商方案（Pairwise Key Agreement Schemes）。摘要给出范围：「This Recommendation specifies key-establishment schemes based on the discrete logarithm problem over finite fields and elliptic curves, including several variations of Diffie-Hellman and Menezes-Qu-Vanstone (MQV) key establishment schemes.」即它管的是离散对数类协商方案的构造与使用条件。 它把一类构造集中成一份可实施的规范：摘要写「This Recommendation specifies key-establishment schemes based on the discrete logarithm problem over finite fields and elliptic curves」，关键词表列出「Diffie-Hellman; elliptic curve cryptography; finite field cryptography; key agreement; key confirmation; key derivation; key establishment; MQV.」——协商、确认与派生在同一份文件里成体系。 落地的是密钥建立方案的选型：文件按使用静态/临时密钥的数量给方案分档（关键词表以 MQV 收束这一族），并在 §5 给出 FFC 与 ECC 两类原语的算法步骤——目录中可见「MQV1 Form of the FFC MQV Primitive」、「Full MQV」与「One-Pass Form of the ECC MQV Primitive」。符合性测试与用语规范位于前言的 Authority 与 Conformance Testing 段落（「The requirements of this Recommendation are indicated by the word “shall.”」）。 限度一是适用条件的原话：这类指南「shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems」，不是无条件适用于所有联邦系统。限度二是文本边界：前言承认部分要求「may be out-of-scope for CAVP or CMVP validation testing」，其后被省略的分句才是责任归属——由使用、实现、安装或配置应用的一方承担。 署名与版次在标题页：作者为 Elaine Barker、Lily Chen、Allen Roginsky、Apostol Vassilev、Richard Davis 五人，标题行写「NIST Special Publication 800-56A Revision 3」，DOI 指向 rev3 版；本文件自身未声明被后续修订取代。 技术参数与复算边界 该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：成对密钥协商方案的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 成对密钥协商方案 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。 复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。 - Wikipedia search entry for 成对密钥协商方案. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E6%88%90%E5%AF%B9%E5%AF%86%E9%92%A5%E5%8D%8F%E5%95%86%E6%96%B9%E6%A1%88 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 成对密钥协商方案的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 密钥建立方案中的密钥派生方法（SP 800-56C）
items.text: 标准 ：密钥建立方案中的密钥派生方法（SP 800-56C Rev.1）（Recommendation for Key-Derivation Methods in Key-Establishment Schemes (SP 800-56C Rev.摘要用一句限定对象与来源：「This Recommendation specifies techniques for the derivation of keying material from a shared secret established during a key-establishment scheme defined in NIST Special Publications 800-56A or 800-56B.」。§2 说明它给出两类做法：「This Recommendation specifies two categories of key-derivation methods that can be employed, as required, as part of a key-establishment scheme specified in [SP 800-56A] or [SP 800-56B].」它的输入是协商得到的共享秘密，不是口令，也不是既有密钥；派生方法本身分单步与两步两类。 §1 交出缺口所在：公钥密钥建立跑完只得到共享秘密，此时「a key-derivation method may be required to obtain secret cryptographic keying material.」§2 解释两步做法为何分两步，第一步只是将共享秘密压成一把派生密钥：「Randomness extraction, to obtain a single cryptographic key-derivation key from a shared secret generated during the execution of a key-establishment scheme」。协商产出的秘密长度与分布并不适合直接当密钥，故派生步骤不可省。 义务写在编号章节里，层级是 shall。§4 对实现者限定辅助函数的选取：「H shall be chosen in accordance with the selection requirements specified in Section 7.」§7 把它展开为四条硬性选型：「Whenever a hash function is employed (including as the primitive used by HMAC), an approved hash function shall be used.」§1 则限定派生结果的算出与用途：「The keying material derived using these methods shall be computed in its entirety before outputting any portion of it」。三句的主语都是实现与配置方：先按 §7 选定 H，再整块算完，然后只当秘密密钥材料使用。 限度分三层。用途上 §1 直接禁止一类用法：「The derived keying material shall not be used as a key stream for a stream cipher.」参数上 §8.2 承认最敏感的一项可以不随机：「This Recommendation does not require the use of a randomly selected salt value.」，§8.3 又把两步法的一种组合排除在外：「At this time, KMAC has not been specified for use in the implementation of a two-step key derivation procedure.」可验证性上，符合性测试一节写明部分要求「may be out-of-scope for CAVP or CMVP validation testing, and thus are the responsibility of entities using, implementing, installing, or configuring applications that incorporate this Recommendation」。 这份副本的版本事实只来自它自己的扉页与横幅：「NIST Special Publication 800-56C Revision 1」与「Recommendation for Key-Derivation Methods in Key-Establishment Schemes」，作者栏「Elaine Barker Lily Chen Rich Davis」；引用行给「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-56C Rev.1, 37 pages (April 2018) CODEN: NSPUE2」，免费获取行后接 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-56Cr1。顶部废止横幅写「The attached publication has been withdrawn (archived), and is provided solely for historical purposes.」并记「SP 800-56C Rev.1 is superseded in its entirety by the publication of SP 800-56C Rev.2.」。致谢页同时覆盖本版与前任工作：「The authors gratefully acknowledge the contributions on this and previous versions of this document by their NIST colleagues (Quynh Dang, Sharon Keller, John Kelsey, Allen Roginsky, Meltem Sonmez Turan, Apostol Vassilev, and Tim Polk) and by Miles Smid, formerly of Orion Security Solutions.」四段引文合起来是这份副本的版本事实：分册与修订号、标题原文、作者栏、页数与出版月份、以 DOI 给出的免费获取地址，以及它被第 2 版整体取代、仅供历史查阅的状态。 - Wikipedia search entry for 密钥建立方案中的密钥派生方法（SP 800-56C Rev. 1）. items.title: 密钥管理
items.text: 标准 ：密钥管理（Key Management）。它的自我定义写在摘要第一句：「This Recommendation provides cryptographic key-management guidance.」下一句说明全书分三部分，而留存的本份是第一部分：「Part 1 provides general guidance and best practices for the management of cryptographic keying material, including definitions of the security services that may be provided when using cryptography and the algorithms and key types that may be employed」。同一摘要把政策与规划要求分派给另一册：「Part 2 provides guidance on policy and security planning requirements for U.S.government agencies.」引文点名其中两类：可用的安全服务定义、可以采用的算法与密钥类型； 每一类密钥需要哪种保护、如何提供 写在同一摘要的后续句里。它因此给出的是框架、术语与保护要求，而不是一份算法规范。 风险陈述在文首的执行摘要：「The proper management of cryptographic keys is essential to the effective use of cryptography for security.」同页紧接一句说明选择错误的代价：「Inappropriate choices may result in an illusion of security but little or no real security for the protocol or application.」§1.1 复述同一个判断，并写出它要处理的成因：「Organizations and developers are presented with many new choices in their use of cryptographic mechanisms.」两句合起来是一个判断：管理失当时算法强度并不等于系统安全，选择失误换来的只是安全感的错觉。 谁该做什么写在编号章节。§5.6.2 面向采购方：「Agencies that procure systems should consider the potential operational lifetime of the system.」并紧跟一条硬性要求：「The agencies shall either select algorithms and key sizes that are expected to be secure during the entire system lifetime or should ensure that the algorithms and key sizes can be easily updated.」§6.1 把保护义务落在密钥信息本身：「Confidentiality protection shall be provided for all secret key information」，以及「Integrity protection shall be provided for all key information.」层级在同一条里就分了手：考虑运行寿命是 should，第一个分支「The agencies shall either select algorithms and key sizes that are expected to be secure during the entire system lifetime」是 shall，第二个分支「or should ensure that the algorithms and key sizes can be easily updated」回落为 should；§6.1 的两条保护则都是 shall 级。 §1.3 的范围段自己划出两条边界。第一条是模块实现：「This Recommendation does not address the implementation details for cryptographic modules that may be used to achieve the identified security requirements.」紧接的一句把细节交回别处：「These details are addressed in FIPS 140,9 the FIPS 140 implementation guidance, and the derived test requirements」（原句在此处接一个 csrc 网址，该条目按发布文本不带 URL 的规矩截到该处之前）」，其后才是归档与备份的运维程序：「This Recommendation does not address the requirements or procedures for operating a key archive or backup capability other than discussing the types of keying material that are appropriate to back up or include in an archive and the protection to be provided to that keying material.」同段还自陈其补位性质：「This Recommendation supplements more focused standards and guidelines.」紧接第一条边界之后另有一句交接：「These details are addressed in FIPS 140」。两条边界合起来的限度是：它规定密钥信息应得何种保护，不规定模块怎样做出，也不给出归档与备份的步骤。 扉页首两行给出「NIST Special Publication 800-57 Part 1 Revision 5」，作者与单位为「Elaine Barker Computer Security Division Information Technology Laboratory」，DOI 行是「This publication is available free of charge from:」，DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-57pt1r5。致谢页记下第五版所继承的前任作者与机构：「The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) gratefully acknowledges and appreciates contributions by previous authors of this document on the many security issues associated with this Recommendation: William Barker, William Burr, and Timothy Polk from NIST; Miles Smid from Orion Security; and Lydia Zieglar from the National Security Agency.」这些都是文件自己的门面信息：分册与修订号、作者与所在部门、以 DOI 给出的免费获取地址，以及致谢点名的前任作者与机构，可见第五版是在早期版本的作者工作之上重写。 - Wikipedia search entry for 密钥管理. \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 密钥管理的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 数字身份指南
items.text: 标准 ：数字身份指南（Digital Identity Guidelines）。留存的这份文件是《数字身份指南》的 B 分册，不是合订的总纲：扉页在编号行之下给出分册题「Authentication and Authenticator Management」，免费获取地址行写「This publication is available free of charge from」行后印着 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-63B-4，即本文件为 B 分册的第 4 版。摘要自述对象：「This guideline focuses on the authentication of subjects who interact with government information systems over networks to establish that a given claimant is a subscriber who has been previously authenticated.」并交代它定什么：「This document defines technical requirements for each of the three authentication assurance levels.」两处措辞与分册题一致：产出是按等级给出的技术要求，范围止于认证与 authenticator 管理。 §1 先把认证拆开定义：「Authentication is the process of determining the validity of one or more authenticators used to claim a digital identity by establishing that a subject attempting to access a digital service is in control of the secrets used to authenticate.」要补的缺口是对手能力的差别，分级正是为此：「Stronger authentication (i.e., a higher AAL) requires malicious actors to have better capabilities and to expend greater resources to successfully subvert the authentication process.」两段合起来说明风险不在算法而在控制关系：要判定的是声明者是否掌握相应秘密，等级则按对手须付出的能力与资源分档。 义务是双向的。§2 对声明者提出要求：「To satisfy the requirements of a given AAL and be recognized as a subscriber, a claimant SHALL authenticate to an RP (or IdP, as described in [SP800-63C]) with a process whose strength is equal to or greater than the requirements at that level.」§3.1.1.2 把口令的具体约束落到验证者与 CSP：「Verifiers and CSPs SHALL require passwords that are used as a single-factor authentication mechanism to be a minimum of 15 characters in length.」以及「When processing a request to establish or change a password, verifiers SHALL compare the prospective secret against a blocklist that contains known commonly used, expected, or compromised passwords.」三条引文同时约束两端：声明者所用过程的强度不得低于该等级，验证者与 CSP 则对口令长度与黑名单比对负有 shall 级义务。 限度写在四处。摘要划出目的边界：「The guidelines are not intended to constrain the development or use of standards outside of this purpose.」§1 划出场景边界：「It does not address the authentication of a person for physical access (e.g., to a building).」同节承认自愿泄露无从拦阻：「The protections at the various AALs are intended to protect against credential theft and are not intended to protect against willful disclosure of credential secrets by a subscriber.」§3.1.1 对最常见的凭证写得更直白：「Passwords are not phishing-resistant.」四条合起来是：目的之外的标准发展它不管，人员物理准入它不管，订阅者自愿共享或泄露没有技术手段可拦，而口令本身不抗钓鱼。 扉页写「NIST SP 800-63B-4 Digital Identity Guidelines Authentication and Authenticator Management」，即 B 册第四版；摘要末句直说：「This publication supersedes NIST Special Publication (SP) 800-63B.」出版史块给出被取代的那一版「Supersedes NIST SP 800-63B (June 2017; updated March 2, 2020)」与评审日期「Approved by the NIST Editorial Review Board on 2025-05-30.」；引用行给出七位作者与 2025 年：「Temoshok D, Fenton JL, Choong YY, Lefkovitz N, Regenscheid A, Galluzzo R, Richer JP (2025) Digital Identity Guidelines: Authentication and Authenticator Management.」扉页日期为 2025 年 7 月，DOI 行给 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-63B-4。目录行号所指的合订总纲与 A、C 两册不在这份文件里。四段引文合起来是这份文件的版本事实：分册号、被取代的上一版及其更新日期、评审批准日期、作者名单与年份。 - Wikipedia search entry for 数字身份指南. https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 数字身份指南的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S items.title: 随机数发生器建议
items.text: 标准 ：随机数发生器建议（Recommendation for Random Number Generation）。摘要一句话定性：「This Recommendation specifies mechanisms for the generation of random bits using deterministic methods.」并给出机制来源：「The methods provided are based on either hash functions or block cipher algorithms.」即它是确定性随机比特生成器的规范，而非熵源规范。 要解决的问题是随机数发生机制的范围界定：摘要写「This Recommendation specifies mechanisms for the generation of random bits using deterministic methods.The methods provided are based on either hash functions or block cipher algorithms.」，§1 把责任压在种子上——「The seed used to instantiate the DRBG must contain sufficient entropy to provide an assurance of randomness.」关键词行是「Deterministic random bit generator (DRBG)…」，属检索入口而非论证。 使用方式是作为被验证模块里的组件：文件对实现方提出的是要求而非引用关系——「A cryptographic module containing a DRBG mechanism shall be validated (see [FIPS 140]).」并且消费 DRBG 的应用或服务方要按文件自己关于熵源与预测阻力的规则提供两者。 限度一是责任分离：本文件只管 DRBG 机制本身，熵源质量与随机数收集在配套文件里，且其参考清单把 SP 800-90B 标为「(Draft)… August 2012」，并把构造级指南另交 SP 800-90C——所以 熵由 90B 解决 在这份文本里只是未定稿。限度二是它不评价具体实现的安全性，验证走 FIPS 140 路径。 版本链在标题页与修订附录：原初版是 June 2006，Revision 1 的三个日期证据都写作 June 2015——页眉「…NIST.SP.800-90Ar1 June 2015」、引用行「Spec.Publ.800-90A Rev.1, 109 pages (June 2015)」与附录 E「In June 2015, the following substantive changes were made in Revision 1 of [SP 800-90A]」。修订记录里最重要的一条是删除：「The Dual_EC_DRBG has been removed, and section numbers adjusted accordingly.」并移除了原先含具体常量的附录。 技术参数与复算边界 该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：随机数发生器建议的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 随机数发生器建议 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。 复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。 - Wikipedia search entry for 随机数发生器建议. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E9%9A%8F%E6%9C%BA%E6%95%B0%E5%8F%91%E7%94%9F%E5%99%A8%E5%BB%BA%E8%AE%AE - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 随机数发生器建议的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: 随机数生成用熵源建议（SP 800-90B）
items.text: 标准 ：随机数生成用熵源建议（SP 800-90B）（Recommendation for the Entropy Sources Used for Random Bit Generation (SP 800-90B)）。摘要写明规定两件事：「This Recommendation specifies the design principles and requirements for the entropy sources used by Random Bit Generators, and the tests for the validation of entropy sources.」并交代它与其他两册的分工：「These entropy sources are intended to be combined with Deterministic Random Bit Generator mechanisms that are specified in SP 800-90A to construct Random Bit Generators, as specified in SP 800-90C.」它管熵源，不管生成器算法本身。两句合起来定出对象与位置：它规定熵源的设计原则、要求与验证测试，随机比特生成器的最终构造交给 90A 与 90C，本文件不定义生成算法本身。 §1.1 从实操困难说起：「However, the generation of random bits is problematic in many practical applications of cryptography.」并把最难的一环交出：「The development of entropy sources that construct unpredictable outputs is difficult, and providing guidance for their design and validation testing is even more so.」同节说明测试思路的前提是开发者理解自己的随机源。§2.2.1 把噪声源抬到根本位置：「The noise source is the root of security for the entropy source and for the RBG as a whole.」三段合起来是理由链条：随机比特在实践里难以产出，难产出的根源是熵源，熵源之难又落在设计与可验证性上；把噪声源称作安全之根，正是把整套随机数体系的地基放在这一层。 义务由实现方与提交方承担，措辞是 shall。§4.3 规定检测组成：「The health tests shall include both continuous and start-up tests.」并规定失败时的动作：「When the health tests fail, the entropy source shall notify the consuming application」，由消费该源的随机数生成器处置。§4.4 把阈值选择交给开发者：「The developer of the entropy source shall determine a reasonable probability of type I error」。度量口径见 §2.1：「this Recommendation uses a very conservative measure known as min-entropy, which measures the effectiveness of the strategy of guessing the most likely output of the entropy source.」引文同时交代口径与责任：min-entropy 是保守度量，检测构成与失败上报是 shall 级，误报概率与阈值则交由开发者按自身噪声源的情形决定。 限度一是检测时机：§4.2 对按需检测只要求具备能力——「This Recommendation does not require performing testing during operation.」同一节的脚注还表明启动条件由 FIPS 140 定，「This document imposes no additional requirements for the use of start-up health testing.」限度二是可验证性：符合性测试一节承认部分要求「may be out-of-scope for CAVP or CMVP validation testing」。限度三是它自身不单独成事：§1.1 写「SP 800-90A addresses the construction of approved DRBG mechanisms, while SP 800-90C addresses the construction of RBGs from the mechanisms in SP 800-90A and the entropy sources in SP 800-90B.」随机位的最终构造在另两册。 扉页首行「NIST Special Publication 800-90B」，标题行「Recommendation for the Entropy Sources Used for Random Bit Generation」，作者行含「Kerry A.McKay Mary L.Baish Mike Boyle」（扉页把第一作者姓名印作 Sönmez Turan，变音符号在留存件里存在；为使每段引文都能逐字核验，姓名写在引号外）；日期行为 2018 年 1 月，引用行「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-90B, 84 pages (January 2018) CODEN: NSPUE2」，免费获取行后接 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-90B。致谢页点名协助者：「The authors of this Recommendation gratefully acknowledge and appreciate contributions by their colleagues at NIST, Apostol Vassilev and Timothy A.Hall」。§1.1 另记与美国家标准的关系：「This Recommendation was developed in concert with American National Standard (ANS) X9.82, a multi-part standard on random number generation.」 - Wikipedia search entry for 随机数生成用熵源建议（SP 800-90B）. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E9%9A%8F%E6%9C%BA%E6%95%B0%E7%94%9F%E6%88%90%E7%94%A8%E7%86%B5%E6%BA%90%E5%BB%BA%E8%AE%AE%EF%BC%88SP%20800-90B%EF%BC%89 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\] 随机数生成用熵源建议（SP 800-90B）的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换
items.text: 协议 ：SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换（SPAKE2+, an Augmented Password-Authenticated Key Exchange (PAKE) Protocol）。RFC 9383 摘要给出机制定义：「This document describes SPAKE2+, a Password-Authenticated Key Exchange (PAKE) protocol run between two parties for deriving a strong shared key with no risk of disclosing the password.」并说明它是增强型：「SPAKE2+ is an augmented PAKE protocol, as only one party has knowledge of the password.」 动机是口令不能裸奔于交换过程：摘要把目标写成「deriving a strong shared key with no risk of disclosing the password」，并把工程卖点列在一起——「This method is simple to implement, compatible with any prime-order group, and computationally efficient.」 使用位置写在 §1：增补性质在执行受限、攻击者无法提前查询口令散列盐值的场景特别有价值，文件举出两类约束——「a constraint may be when physical proximity through a local network is required or when a first authentication factor is required for initiation of the protocol.」摘要给出通用形态：只有一侧持有口令，仍完成认证并得到会话密钥。 限度一是身份模型：「SPAKE2+ is the asymmetric or augmented version of SPAKE2, wherein only one party has knowledge of the password.」服务器侧仍需保存盐值/记录。限度二是标准地位：文件自陈「Neither SPAKE2 nor SPAKE2+ was selected as the result of the Crypto Forum Research Group (CFRG) PAKE selection competition.」，页眉 Category 为 Informational，不是 Standards Track。 版本信息在页眉：流别为 Independent Submission，Category 标注 Informational，日期 September 2023，作者 T.Taubert（Apple Inc.）与 C.A.Wood。§1 交代血缘：本文内容从「[RFC9382], which specifies SPAKE2」拆出，因对称与增补 PAKE 的用例不同而分别规范。 技术参数与复算边界 该条目的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。 预期输出：按 SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。 复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。 - Wikipedia search entry for SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=SPAKE2%2B%20%E5%8F%A3%E4%BB%A4%E8%AE%A4%E8%AF%81%E5%AF%86%E9%92%A5%E4%BA%A4%E6%8D%A2 - Handbook of Applied Cryptography (Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone). https://www.cacr.math.uwaterloo.ca/hac/ 形式模型与复算步骤 \[\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\] SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。1.把协议消息序列写成状态机。2.用混合论证逐个替换原语。3.把剩余优势归约到 PRF/AEAD 安全。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

items.title: SRTP 安全实时传输
items.text: 协议 ：SRTP 安全实时传输（Secure Real-time Transport Protocol）。RFC 3711 摘要给出定位与能力清单：「This document describes the Secure Real-time Transport Protocol (SRTP), a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP), which can provide confidentiality, message authentication, and replay protection to the RTP traffic and to the control traffic for RTP, the Real-time Transport Control Protocol (RTCP).」即它是 RTP 的密码学剖面，同时管媒体与控制流量。 摘要说明它给 RTP 与 RTCP 控制流量补上安全服务：「a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP), which can provide confidentiality, message authentication, and replay protection to the RTP traffic and to the control traffic for RTP, the Real-time Transport Control Protocol (RTCP).」注意措辞是 can provide——能力取决于所选密码套件与密钥管理，不是默认全开。 使用面是音视频与实时会话的承载加密：文档以「a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP)」界定其作用位置，并在框架一节定义密码上下文与包处理流程；语音、视频会议等实现按该剖面套用在既有 RTP 报文之上。 限度一是它不规定密钥管理协议：§1 明确安全性有条件——「With appropriate key management (Sections 7 and 8), SRTP is secure (Sections 9) for unicast and multicast RTP applications (Section 11).」§8 名为 Key Management Considerations，对所使用的密钥管理提出约束，却不定义协商协议。限度二是保护范围只到 RTP/RTCP 流量，与应用层协议无关。 版本信息在页眉与版权块：Request for Comments 3711，Network Working Group，日期 March 2004，版权行为「Copyright (C) The Internet Society (2004).All Rights Reserved.」（IETF Trust 的版权样式属于此后的文件）。本文件的自我定位是 RTP 的一个 profile，而非新的传输协议。 技术参数与复算边界 该条目的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：SRTP 安全实时传输的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。 预期输出：按 SRTP 安全实时传输 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。 复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。 - items.title: 隐写分析
items.text: 术语 ：隐写分析（Steganalysis）。 为何需要检测隐藏的存在，本章在服务层面给了两句一般性理由。其一是把侦测纳入学科本身：「Cryptography is about the prevention and detection of cheating and other malicious activities.」即预防与检测并列，隐藏通信的检测因此属于同一问题域，而非另属他科。其二是把检测写成完整性服务的前提：「To assure data integrity, one must have the ability to detect data manipulation by unauthorized parties.」两句共同支撑该条目：只要未被察觉的增删替换足以破坏完整性，判定隐藏存在与否的能力就是服务的前提条件。需要区分的是，这两句说的是未经授权的改动与恶意行为，并未专指隐写载体，故本章为隐写分析提供的是问题定位，不是任务规格。 留存的用法只到问题归类为止。注释先列物理手段：「Physical means of providing privacy include fiber optic communication links, spread spectrum technology, TEMPEST techniques,」其句收在「tamper-resistant hardware.」；隐写不在这一串清单之内，同段紧随的下一句另把它定义为信息隐私的一个分支（该条目 principle 段所引），隐形墨水、秘密夹层与次限信道是该分支自身的设备。即本章把隐蔽处理安放在物理手段清单之后的单独一句里，而对应的分析手段没有清单。另一处用法是目标划分：「it was realized that secrecy and authentication were truly separate and independent information security objectives.」两句合起来决定隐写分析在本章中的可用方式：它可作为保密性之外的第三问（是否根本存在一条消息）被提出，并可借助扩展频谱与 TEMPEST 一类并置手段作类比；但本章不含图像载体、统计检验或检测率的任何应用实例，因此不得把上述并置当作方法依据。 限度由文本自陈的适用面划定：「This book only considers cryptography as it applies to information in digital form.」这一句同时切断两个方向：一是隐形墨水与秘密夹层之类非数字载体，本章只在注释里列举其名；二是数字隐写的检测问题，本章既未定义也未给出任何检验流程。加之该节的文献指针指向史料而非方法，「Kahn [648] provides an historical account of various steganographic techniques.」故该条目的结论是证据边界而非学科边界：留存文本能说明隐写所遮蔽的是数据的存在，不能说明如何判定其存在；任何检测效能、误报率或针对具体载体的分析结论，均超出这一份副本所能引证的范围。 史料线索在本章以指针形式出现：「Kahn [648] provides an historical account of various steganographic techniques.」该句位于章末注释，把隐形墨水、秘密夹层与次限信道一类手段的沿革交给另一部著作，而这句话本身没有为它点名的那些手段补上任何年份。副本的版本事实写在题头行：「This is a Chapter from the Handbook of Applied Cryptography, by A.Menezes, P.van Oorschot, and S.Vanstone, CRC Press, 1996.」即这份单章文本标注 1996 年，且明言是手册的一章。两条合起来只够说明这份副本自身的写法：章末注释另起一句把隐写定义为信息隐私的一个分支，并把次限信道列为该分支的设备之一，而非把隐写列入提供隐私的物理手段清单，作证的是该句本身「Steganography is that branch of information privacy which attempts to obscure the existence of data through such devices as invisible inks, secret compartments, the use of subliminal channels, and the like.」；全章没有使用 steganalysis 一词，故本副本未为该词留下条目或定义。这只是一份单章文本的写法，不足以断言 1996 年整个领域的状况。这份副本印出的年份说的是副本自己与其他书：题头行印着 1996，一行把 1997 年列为 CRC Press 版权年的说明在这份副本里出现 25 次，而与本章第一节绑定的注释给出 1967 年——那是 Kahn 那部密码学通史出版的年份。这三个年份都不说明 steganalysis 一词何时开始使用，本章也没有任何句子能为它断代。 - Wikipedia search entry for 隐写分析. https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=%E9%9A%90%E5%86%99%E5%88%86%E6%9E%90 - RFC 4949: Internet Security Glossary, Version 2. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4949 定义检查模型 上位概念 → 区别特征
